This paper presents a peak analysis of 2k news about Brazilian fires and landslides in German newspapers from 2000 to 2024. Using time series segmentation to detect news event peaks, we examine the extent to which they can be temporally aligned with observations in national and global disaster databases.
zh_title: 巴西灾害的新闻价值：巴西灾害国际媒体关注度时间序列的峰值分析
translation: 媒体报道影响灾害响应，但国际媒体对本地事件的关注驱动因素尚不完全清楚。巴西提供了一个引人注目的案例：其部分自然和技术灾害偶尔会登上国际头条。然而，关于这些事件为何在国外被讨论的系统性分析仍然缺失。填补这一空白需要具有代表性、经过验证且针对特定国家的新闻数据集。本文对2000年至2024年德国报纸中关于巴西火灾和滑坡的2000条新闻进行了峰值分析。通过使用时间序列分段来检测新闻事件峰值，我们考察了它们在多大程度上可以与国家和全球灾害数据库中的观测结果在时间上保持一致。
tldr: 本文通过分析德国媒体对巴西火灾和滑坡的报道，揭示了国际媒体关注灾害事件的时间规律。
ai_comments: 该研究填补了关于国际媒体对特定国家灾害关注度驱动因素研究的空白，通过时间序列分析将媒体报道与灾害数据库对接，具有较强的实证意义。其局限性在于仅局限于德国媒体及火灾与滑坡两类灾害。
motivation: 尽管媒体报道影响灾害响应，但国际媒体关注本地灾害的驱动因素尚不明确，且缺乏针对巴西灾害报道的系统性分析。
method: 采用时间序列分段方法检测新闻事件峰值，并将其与国家及全球灾害数据库进行时间对齐分析。
results: 通过对2000年至2024年间德国报纸中关于巴西火灾和滑坡的2000条新闻进行分析，量化了媒体关注度的峰值，并评估了其与实际灾害数据库的吻合程度。
conclusion: 研究通过时间序列峰值分析，有效识别并量化了巴西灾害在德国媒体报道中的特征，为理解国际新闻报道的规律提供了实证依据。

title: Counter-Dyna: Data-Efficient RL-Based HVAC Control using Counterfactual Building Models
authors: Jan Marco Ruiz de Vargas, Fabian Raisch, Zoltan Nagy, Pierre Pinson, Christoph Goebel
abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) offers a promising approach for data-efficient energy management in buildings, combining the strengths of predictive modeling and reinforcement learning. While previous MBRL methods applied to HVAC control have reduced training data requirements, they still require several months of interaction with the building to learn a satisfactory control policy. A key reason is that existing surrogate models attempt to predict the entire state-space, including weather and electricity prices that are unaffected by control actions, or completely ignore these variables. Addressing these issues, we propose Counter-Dyna, a method that enhances the data-efficiency of Dyna, an MBRL method. We create data-efficient counterfactual surrogate models (CSM) by leveraging invariances in the state-space. Using a CSM in Dyna speeds up RL training measured in environment interaction data compared to previous results. In comparison with previous state-of-the-art that used 6-12 months of environment interactions, our method needs only 5 weeks. We evaluate our method in a large simulation study using the literature standard BOPTEST framework and proximal policy algorithm (PPO) as the RL algorithm. Our results show cost-saving potentials of 5.3% to 17.0% in a hypothetical deployment scenario. Our work is a significant step towards making real-world deployment of RL algorithms in HVAC control practically viable.
zh_title: Counter-Dyna：基于反事实建筑模型的HVAC系统数据高效强化学习控制
translation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）为建筑节能管理提供了一种有前景的方法，结合了预测建模和强化学习的优势。尽管以往应用于HVAC控制的MBRL方法减少了训练数据需求，但它们仍需要数月的建筑交互来学习满意的控制策略。一个关键原因是现有的代理模型试图预测整个状态空间，包括不受控制动作影响的天气和电价，或者完全忽略了这些变量。针对这些问题，我们提出了 Counter-Dyna，这是一种增强 Dyna（一种MBRL方法）数据效率的方法。我们通过利用状态空间的恒定性来创建数据高效的反事实代理模型（CSM）。在 Dyna 中使用 CSM 可以加快强化学习训练，相较于以往的研究，减少了环境交互数据需求。与此前使用6-12个月环境交互的最先进方法相比，我们的方法仅需5周。我们在使用文献标准 BOPTEST 框架和近端策略优化（PPO）算法的大型仿真研究中评估了我们的方法。结果显示，在假设的部署场景中，其具有5.3%至17.0%的节能潜力。我们的工作是使强化学习算法在 HVAC 控制中的实际部署迈向可行性的重要一步。
tldr: Counter-Dyna 通过构建反事实代理模型，将HVAC强化学习控制的训练数据需求从数月缩短至5周，同时实现显著节能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入反事实代理模型（CSM）有效解决了建筑HVAC控制中模型预测冗余信息的问题，显著降低了强化学习对交互数据的需求。该方法将训练时间从数月缩短至数周，在实际部署可行性方面迈出了重要一步，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在HVAC控制中仍需要数月的环境交互数据，原因是代理模型试图预测所有状态（包括不受控制影响的天气和电价），导致学习效率低下。
method: 提出 Counter-Dyna 方法，通过识别状态空间中的恒定性构建反事实代理模型（CSM），将其集成到 Dyna 架构中，并结合 PPO 算法进行训练。
results: 该方法仅需5周的环境交互数据即可训练出满意的控制策略，相比现有方法（6-12个月）效率大幅提升，并在仿真中实现了5.3%至17.0%的节能效果。
conclusion: Counter-Dyna 通过利用状态空间的恒定性构建反事实代理模型，极大地提升了HVAC控制中强化学习的样本效率，使其在现实场景中的应用更加可行。

title: Benchmarking LLMs on the Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
authors: Cyril Allauzen, Tom Bagby, Georg Heigold, Ehsan Variani, Ke Wu
abstract: The Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB) has emerged as a standard for evaluating the functional breadth of audio models. While initial baselines focused on specialized encoders, the shift toward "audio-native" Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests a new paradigm where a single multimodal backbone may replace complex, task-specific pipelines. This paper provides a rigorous empirical evaluation of leading LLMs - including members from the Gemini and GPT families - across the eight core MSEB capabilities to assess their efficacy and audio-text parity. Our results indicate that while a significant modality gap persists regarding performance and robustness, the empirical evidence for an "optimal" modeling approach remains inconclusive. Ultimately, the choice between audionative and cascaded architectures depends heavily on specific use-case requirements and the underlying assumptions regarding latency, cost, and reasoning depth.
zh_title: 在海量音频嵌入基准（MSEB）上对大语言模型进行基准测试
translation: 海量音频嵌入基准（MSEB）已成为评估音频模型功能广度的标准。虽然最初的基准测试侧重于专用编码器，但向“音频原生”大语言模型（LLM）的转变暗示了一种新范式，即单一多模态主干网可能取代复杂的、特定于任务的流水线。本文对领先的LLM（包括Gemini和GPT系列成员）在八项核心MSEB能力上进行了严格的实证评估，以评估其功效和音频-文本对齐能力。我们的结果表明，虽然在性能和鲁棒性方面仍存在显著的模态差距，但关于“最优”建模方法的实证证据尚无定论。最终，音频原生架构和级联架构之间的选择在很大程度上取决于特定的用例需求以及对延迟、成本和推理深度的基本假设。
tldr: 本文评估了主流大语言模型在音频任务上的表现，发现目前大模型尚无法完全替代专用架构，且不同架构的选择需根据实际应用场景权衡。
ai_comments: 该论文通过在MSEB基准上评估主流LLM，揭示了当前多模态模型在音频理解任务上的局限性。其创新点在于将传统音频评估框架应用于大模型，强调了在实际应用中选择架构时需要权衡性能、成本与延迟，对多模态音频技术选型具有指导意义。
motivation: 随着“音频原生”大语言模型的兴起，需要评估它们是否能够替代传统的、针对特定任务的音频处理流水线，并考察其音频-文本的对齐能力。
method: 在包含八项核心能力的MSEB（Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark）基准上，对包括Gemini和GPT系列在内的领先大语言模型进行了严格的实证评估。
results: 研究发现，当前大模型在音频处理的性能和鲁棒性方面仍存在显著的“模态差距”，且目前没有证据表明哪种建模方法（音频原生或级联架构）在所有场景下均占优。
conclusion: 目前尚不存在单一的“最优”架构，音频原生模型与级联架构的取舍取决于具体的应用场景、延迟要求、成本预算及推理深度。

title: InterMesh: Explicit Interaction-Aware End-to-End Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery
authors: Kaili Zheng, Kaiwen Wang, Xun Zhu, Chenyi Guo, Ji Wu
abstract: Humans constantly interact with their surroundings. Existing end-to-end multi-person human mesh recovery methods, typically based on the DETR framework, capture inter-human relationships through self-attention across all human queries. However, these approaches model interactions only implicitly and lack explicit reasoning about how humans interact with objects and with each other. In this paper, we propose InterMesh, a simple yet effective framework that explicitly incorporates human-environment interaction information into human mesh recovery pipeline. By leveraging a human-object interaction detector, InterMesh enriches query representations with structured interaction semantics, enabling more accurate pose and shape estimation. We design lightweight modules, Contextual Interaction Encoder and Interaction-Guided Refiner, to integrate these features into existing HMR architectures with minimal overhead. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on 3DPW, MuPoTS, CMU Panoptic, Hi4D, and CHI3D datasets, demonstrating remarkable improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Notably, InterMesh reduces MPJPE by 9.9% on CMU Panoptic and 8.2% on Hi4D, highlighting its effectiveness in scenarios with complex human-object and inter-human interactions.

title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis
authors: Vlad Vasilescu, Daniela Faur, Teodor Costachioiu
abstract: High-resolution satellite images are often scarce and costly, especially for remote areas or infrequent events. This shortage hampers the development and testing of machine learning models for land-cover classification, change detection, and disaster monitoring. In this paper, we tackle the problem of geometry-controlled high-resolution satellite image synthesis by adding control over existing pre-trained diffusion models. We propose a simple yet efficient method for controlling the synthesis process by leveraging only skip connection features using windowed cross-attention modules. Several previously established control techniques are compared, indicating that our method achieves comparable performance while leading to a better alignment with the geometry control map. We also discuss the limitations in current evaluation approaches, amplifying the necessity of a consistent alignment assessment.
comment: 2026 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS)
zh_title: 高效的几何控制高分辨率卫星图像合成
translation: 高分辨率卫星图像往往稀缺且昂贵，特别是在偏远地区或罕见事件中。这种短缺阻碍了用于土地覆盖分类、变化检测和灾害监测的机器学习模型的开发和测试。在本文中，我们通过增加对现有预训练扩散模型的控制，解决了几何控制的高分辨率卫星图像合成问题。我们提出了一种简单而高效的方法，通过仅利用窗口交叉注意力模块的跳跃连接特征来控制合成过程。通过与几种先前建立的控制技术进行比较，表明我们的方法在实现相当性能的同时，与几何控制图的对齐效果更好。我们还讨论了当前评估方法中的局限性，强调了进行一致性对齐评估的必要性。
tldr: 通过在扩散模型中加入简单的窗口交叉注意力模块，实现了对高分辨率卫星图像的高效几何控制合成。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种轻量且高效的几何控制方法，通过利用预训练扩散模型的跳跃连接特征，实现了高质量卫星图像合成。其创新点在于简化了控制模块，并在几何对齐方面取得了优于现有技术的表现，这对数据稀缺的遥感领域具有重要意义。不过，论文也指出了当前评估方法的不一致性，这为后续研究指明了方向。
motivation: 高分辨率卫星图像获取成本高且稀缺，限制了遥感领域机器学习模型的发展，因此需要一种高效的图像合成方法来生成受几何约束的图像。
method: 提出了一种利用窗口交叉注意力模块（windowed cross-attention modules）和预训练扩散模型跳跃连接特征（skip connection features）的几何控制方法。
results: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持与现有技术相当的合成性能的同时，实现了与几何控制图更好的对齐效果。
conclusion: 该研究证明了仅利用跳跃连接特征结合窗口交叉注意力模块，即可实现对预训练扩散模型的高效几何控制，为解决遥感领域高分辨率图像数据匮乏问题提供了一种有效途径。

title: SAMIC: A Lightweight Semantic-Aware Mamba for Efficient Perceptual Image Compression
authors: Jiaqian Zhang, Hao Wei, Chenyang Ge, Yanhui Zhou
abstract: Perceptual image compression focuses on preserving high visual quality under low-bitrate constraints. Most existing approaches to perceptual compression leverage the strong generative capabilities of generative adversarial networks or diffusion models, at the cost of substantial model complexity. To this end, we present an efficient perceptual image compression method that exploits the long-range modeling capability and linear computational complexity of state space models, with a particular focus on Mamba. Unlike existing methods that rely on an inherently fixed scanning order and consequently impair semantic continuity and spatial correlation, we develop a semantic-aware Mamba block (SAMB) to enable scanning guided by dynamically clustered semantic features, thereby alleviating the strict causality constraints and long-range information decay inherent to Mamba. Inspired by singular value decomposition, we design an SVD-inspired redundancy reduction module (SVD-RRM) that performs a low-rank approximation on the latent features by introducing a learnable soft threshold, leading to channel-wise redundancy information reduction. The proposed SAMB is integrated into both the encoder and decoder of the compression framework, whereas the SVD-RRM is incorporated only in the encoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art approaches in terms of rate-distortion-perception tradeoff and model complexity. The source code and pretrained models will be available at https://github.com/Jasmine-aiq/SAMIC.
zh_title: SAMIC：一种用于高效感知图像压缩的轻量级语义感知 Mamba
translation: 感知图像压缩致力于在低比特率约束下保持高视觉质量。大多数现有的感知压缩方法利用生成对抗网络或扩散模型的强大生成能力，但付出了巨大的模型复杂性代价。为此，我们提出了一种高效的感知图像压缩方法，利用状态空间模型（特别是 Mamba）的长程建模能力和线性计算复杂度。与依赖固定扫描顺序并削弱语义连续性和空间相关性的现有方法不同，我们开发了一种语义感知 Mamba 块（SAMB），通过动态聚类的语义特征引导扫描，从而缓解了 Mamba 固有的严格因果约束和长程信息衰减。受奇异值分解的启发，我们设计了一个 SVD 启发式冗余缩减模块（SVD-RRM），通过引入可学习的软阈值对潜在特征进行低秩近似，从而实现通道级冗余信息的缩减。SAMB 被集成到压缩框架的编码器和解码器中，而 SVD-RRM 仅集成在编码器中。大量实验证明，我们的方法在率-失真-感知权衡和模型复杂度方面均优于最先进的方法。源代码和预训练模型将在 https://github.com/Jasmine-aiq/SAMIC 提供。
tldr: SAMIC 结合 Mamba 和 SVD 技术，通过语义感知扫描和冗余缩减，实现了低复杂度下的高性能感知图像压缩。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型（Mamba）应用于感知图像压缩，通过语义感知扫描机制和SVD启发的冗余缩减模块，成功平衡了模型复杂度和视觉质量，为轻量化高性能图像压缩提供了新思路。
motivation: 现有的感知图像压缩方法多依赖生成式对抗网络或扩散模型，导致模型计算复杂度过高；同时，传统 Mamba 的固定扫描顺序限制了语义连续性和空间相关性。
method: 提出了 SAMIC 框架，包含两个核心组件：1. 语义感知 Mamba 块 (SAMB)，通过动态聚类引导扫描以优化语义连续性；2. SVD 启发冗余缩减模块 (SVD-RRM)，利用低秩近似和可学习软阈值去除通道冗余。
results: 实验表明，SAMIC 在率-失真-感知权衡和模型复杂度方面均优于当前最先进的图像压缩方法。
conclusion: SAMIC 方法通过引入语义感知 Mamba 模块和 SVD 冗余缩减，在保持低计算复杂度的同时，实现了优于现有前沿方法的率-失真-感知性能权衡。

title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios
authors: Jian Wu, Ulrich Sander, Carol Flannagan, Jonas Bärgman
abstract: The representativeness of synthetic pre-crash scenarios is crucial for assessing the safety impact of Driving Automation Systems through virtual simulations. However, a gap remains in the robust evaluation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios' practical equivalence to their real-world counterparts; that is, whether they are similar enough for the intended assessment purpose. Conventional significance testing is inadequate, as it focuses on detecting differences rather than establishing practical equivalence. This study addresses the research gap by extending our previous work on a Bayesian Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE)-based equivalence testing framework by introducing a binning-based approach to define appropriate statistics and equivalence criteria. Two binning-based statistics are proposed to measure practically meaningful distributional differences between datasets in the context of safety impact assessment. The framework's applicability is demonstrated through a case study, which tests the practical equivalence of two synthetic rear-end pre-crash datasets with a previously developed reference dataset in the context of the safety impact assessment of an Automatic Emergency Braking system. The results show that the framework provides informative quantitative assessments of practical equivalence as well as diagnostic insights into the divergence of datasets. Although the demonstration focuses on rear-end pre-crash scenarios, the framework is generic and extensible to broader validation contexts, providing an interpretable and principled basis for practical equivalence assessment across diverse synthetic data applications.
zh_title: 合成预碰撞场景的实际验证
translation: 合成预碰撞场景的代表性对于通过虚拟仿真评估驾驶自动化系统的安全影响至关重要。然而，在评估合成预碰撞场景与其真实世界对应场景的实际等效性（即它们是否足以满足预期的评估目的）方面，仍存在差距。传统的显著性检验是不够的，因为它侧重于检测差异而不是建立实际等效性。本研究通过引入基于分箱的方法来定义适当的统计量和等效性准则，扩展了我们之前关于基于贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）的等效性检验框架，从而解决了这一研究空白。提出了两种基于分箱的统计量，用于在安全影响评估的背景下测量数据集之间具有实际意义的分布差异。通过一个案例研究证明了该框架的适用性，该研究在自动紧急制动系统的安全影响评估背景下，测试了两个合成追尾预碰撞数据集与先前开发的参考数据集的实际等效性。结果表明，该框架提供了关于实际等效性的信息性定量评估，以及对数据集差异的诊断见解。尽管演示集中在追尾预碰撞场景，但该框架是通用的，可扩展到更广泛的验证环境，为跨不同合成数据应用的实际等效性评估提供了一个可解释和原则性的基础。
tldr: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯ROPE和分箱技术的通用框架，用于定量评估虚拟仿真中合成预碰撞场景与真实场景的实际等效性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）框架和分箱统计方法，解决了虚拟仿真中合成场景与真实场景等效性评估的难题，为自动驾驶系统的安全性验证提供了一种定量且可解释的科学评估手段，具有很高的工程实用价值。
motivation: 现有的显著性检验方法侧重于检测差异而非建立实际等效性，无法满足自动驾驶系统虚拟仿真中对合成预碰撞场景代表性评估的需求。
method: 引入了一种基于分箱（binning-based）的方法来定义统计量和等效性准则，并基于贝叶斯等效区域（ROPE）框架对合成数据集与参考数据集进行实际等效性测试。
results: 案例研究表明，该框架不仅能提供合成数据集与参考数据集之间实际等效性的定量评估，还能识别数据集的具体差异，证实了其在自动驾驶紧急制动系统评估中的有效性。
conclusion: 该研究提出的基于分箱的贝叶斯ROPE框架能够有效评估合成预碰撞场景与真实数据的实际等效性，并能提供数据集差异的诊断见解，适用于更广泛的自动驾驶系统安全性验证场景。

title: Delay-Aware Large-Small Model Collaboration over LEO Satellite Networks
authors: Mingyu Guo, Wen Wu, Ying Wang, Songge Zhang, Liang Li
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a delay-aware largesmall model collaboration scheme for low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks, which can balance the computational load among satellites and the communication load across inter-satellite links. Specifically, computational resource constrained remote sensing satellites are responsible for data collection and local processing using small models, while collaborating with computing satellites that provide large model processing. To minimize the service delay, we formulate a joint optimization problem for offloading decision and routing strategy design, which is transformed into a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process. To solve the problem, we develop a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based algorithm with offline policy training and online bisection search. The offline trained policy determines routing strategies, while online bisection search iteratively adjusts the offloading decisions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme can reduce the service delay by up to 31.85% compared with the benchmarks.
zh_title: 面向低地球轨道卫星网络的延迟感知大小模型协同机制
translation: 在本文中，我们为低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络引入了一种延迟感知的大小模型协同方案，该方案可以平衡卫星间的计算负载和卫星间链路的通信负载。具体而言，计算资源受限的遥感卫星负责使用小模型进行数据收集和本地处理，同时与提供大模型处理的计算卫星进行协作。为了最小化服务延迟，我们制定了一个关于卸载决策和路由策略设计的联合优化问题，并将其转换为去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程。为了解决该问题，我们开发了一种基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的算法，结合了离线策略训练和在线二分搜索。离线训练的策略决定路由策略，而在线二分搜索则迭代调整卸载决策。仿真结果表明，与基准方案相比，所提出的方案可以将服务延迟降低高达31.85%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多智能体强化学习的大小模型协同机制，通过优化LEO卫星网络的计算卸载与路由，成功将服务延迟降低了31.85%。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大模型和小模型协作机制引入LEO卫星网络，有效解决了计算资源受限与服务延迟之间的矛盾。通过将复杂的联合优化问题建模为去中心化POMDP并采用MARL算法求解，具有较强的实际应用价值。局限性在于未详述卫星间链路的动态拓扑稳定性对算法性能的影响。
motivation: 为了解决低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络中计算资源受限、链路通信负载不均导致的业务服务延迟高的问题，旨在实现卫星间的计算与通信负载均衡。
method: 提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的算法，包含线下策略训练（用于路由决策）和线上二分搜索（用于调整卸载决策），以解决去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。
results: 仿真结果表明，该方案与现有基准相比，能够将服务延迟降低高达31.85%。
conclusion: 提出的协同方案通过优化计算卸载与路由策略，显著降低了LEO卫星网络中的服务延迟，验证了大小模型协作架构在卫星边缘计算中的有效性。

title: Beyond Static Best-of-N: Bayesian List-wise Alignment for LLM-based Recommendation
authors: Ruijun Chen, Chongming Gao, Jiawei Chen, Weiqin Yang, Xiangnan He
abstract:
Large Language Models have revolutionized recommender systems (LLM4Rec) by leveraging their generative capabilities to model complex user preferences. However, existing LLM4Rec methods primarily rely on token-level objectives, making it difficult to optimize list-level and non-differentiable metrics (e.g., NDCG, fairness) that define actual recommendation quality. While Best-of-N (BoN) directly optimizes these metrics during inference, its high computational cost hinders real-world deployment. To address this, BoN Alignment aims to distill the search capability into the model itself, yet current approaches suffer from two critical limitations: (1) Indiscriminate Supervision, where the static reference fails to distinguish the relative quality of candidates exceeding its empirical range, leading to a loss of ranking guidance; and (2) Gradient Decay, where the effective supervision signal rapidly diminishes as the evolving policy improves, resulting in inefficient optimization.
  To overcome these challenges, we propose BLADE (Bayesian List-wise Alignment via Dynamic Estimation). Unlike static approaches, BLADE introduces a Bayesian framework that continuously updates the target distribution by fusing historical priors with dynamic evidence from the model's current rollouts. This mechanism constructs a self-evolving target that adapts to the model's growing capabilities, ensuring the training signal remains informative throughout the learning process. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that BLADE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, it breaks the static performance upper bound, achieving sustained gains in both ranking accuracy (Recall, NDCG) and complex list-wise metrics (Fairness, Diversity). The code is available via https://github.com/RegionCh/BLADE.
zh_title: 超越静态Best-of-N：面向大语言模型推荐的贝叶斯列表式对齐
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）通过利用其生成能力建模复杂的用户偏好，彻底改变了推荐系统（LLM4Rec）。然而，现有的LLM4Rec方法主要依赖token级目标，难以优化定义实际推荐质量的列表级和不可微指标（如NDCG、公平性）。虽然Best-of-N（BoN）在推理过程中直接优化这些指标，但其高昂的计算成本阻碍了实际部署。为了解决这一问题，BoN对齐旨在将搜索能力蒸馏到模型本身，但当前方法存在两个关键限制：（1）无差别监督，即静态参考无法区分超出其经验范围的候选者的相对质量，导致排序指导丢失；（2）梯度衰减，即随着演进策略的改进，有效的监督信号迅速减弱，导致优化效率低下。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了BLADE（通过动态估计进行贝叶斯列表式对齐）。与静态方法不同，BLADE引入了一个贝叶斯框架，通过融合历史先验与模型当前滚出的动态证据，持续更新目标分布。这种机制构建了一个适应模型不断增长能力的自演进目标，确保训练信号在整个学习过程中保持信息量。在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，BLADE显著优于最先进的基线。至关重要的是，它打破了静态性能上限，在排序准确性（Recall、NDCG）和复杂的列表级指标（公平性、多样性）方面均实现了持续增长。代码可通过 https://github.com/RegionCh/BLADE 获取。
tldr: BLADE通过贝叶斯动态目标更新，解决了LLM推荐中静态对齐方法的性能瓶颈与训练效率问题，实现了推荐效果的持续优化。
ai_comments: 该研究针对LLM推荐系统中Best-of-N方法计算成本高且现有对齐方法存在监督局限的问题，提出了动态贝叶斯对齐框架。其创新点在于引入了自演进目标分布，有效解决了梯度衰减和静态监督不足的问题，在提升推荐性能的同时兼顾了公平性和多样性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有LLM推荐系统多依赖token级目标，难以优化非微分的列表级指标；而Best-of-N计算成本过高，且现有的对齐方法存在监督分辨力不足（Indiscriminate Supervision）和梯度随模型进化而衰减（Gradient Decay）的问题。
method: 提出BLADE（Bayesian List-wise Alignment via Dynamic Estimation）框架，通过贝叶斯方法融合历史先验与模型当前滚出的动态证据，构建随模型能力提升而自演进的训练目标，从而解决静态监督和梯度衰减问题。
results: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，BLADE显著优于现有基线方法，在Recall、NDCG等排序指标以及公平性、多样性等复杂列表指标上均实现了持续提升，突破了静态性能上限。
conclusion: BLADE通过构建动态更新的贝叶斯目标分布，成功解决了LLM推荐系统中的静态监督限制和梯度衰减问题，实现了推荐性能的持续优化。

title: RangeGuard: Efficient, Bounded Approximate Error Correction for Reliable DNNs
authors: Hanum Ko, Sangheum Yeon, Jong Hwan Ko, Jungrae Kim
abstract:
As DRAM scales in density and adopts 3D integration, raw fault rates increase and multi-bit errors are no longer rare. Such errors can severely impact Deep Neural Networks (DNNs): although DNNs tolerate small numerical perturbations, random bit flips can create extreme outliers that propagate and sharply degrade accuracy. Large Language Models (LLMs) are particularly vulnerable because attention, residual, and normalization layers can amplify and preserve a single corrupted activation across many layers, destabilizing inference.
  This paper introduces RangeGuard, a metadata-centric error-correcting framework that provides strong reliability and high efficiency based on bounded approximate correction. Instead of protecting raw bits, RangeGuard encodes compact Range Identifiers (RIDs) that capture the numerical range of each value. These compact metadata enable efficient use of limited redundancy and concentrate protection on range changes, which indicate harmful semantic deviations, while ignoring benign intra-range variations. Upon detecting a range change, RangeGuard restores the correct range and substitutes a representative value, ensuring that error magnitudes are bounded within the range. Based on RIDs, RangeGuard can tolerate 64+ flipped bits using only 16 bits of parity available in GPU memories without a noticeable accuracy loss. By introducing semantic range protection, RangeGuard enables reliable DNN execution even under frequent memory errors and tight redundancy budgets.
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to the 53rd Annual IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Computer Architecture (ISCA 2026)
zh_title: RangeGuard：面向可靠DNN的高效、有界近似纠错机制
translation: 随着DRAM密度的扩展和3D集成的采用，原始故障率不断增加，多位错误已不再罕见。此类错误会严重影响深度神经网络（DNN）：尽管DNN对小的数值扰动具有容忍度，但随机比特翻转会产生极端的离群值，这些离群值会传播并急剧降低准确性。大语言模型（LLM）尤其脆弱，因为注意力层、残差层和归一化层可以放大并保留跨多个层的单个损坏激活值，从而导致推理不稳定。本文介绍了RangeGuard，这是一个以元数据为中心的纠错框架，基于有界近似纠错提供强大的可靠性和高效率。RangeGuard不是保护原始位，而是编码紧凑的范围标识符（RIDs），用以捕获每个值的数值范围。这些紧凑的元数据能够有效利用有限的冗余，并将保护集中在表示有害语义偏差的范围变化上，同时忽略良性的范围内波动。在检测到范围变化时，RangeGuard会恢复正确的范围并替换一个代表值，确保错误幅度被限制在范围内。基于RIDs，RangeGuard可以在仅使用GPU内存中可用的16位奇偶校验位的情况下，容忍64位以上的比特翻转，且不会产生明显的准确度损失。通过引入语义范围保护，RangeGuard即使在频繁的内存错误和严格的冗余预算下，也能实现可靠的DNN执行。
tldr: RangeGuard通过监控数值范围而非纠正所有比特错误，以极低的开销实现了DNN在严重内存故障下的高可靠性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地从数值语义而非底层位纠错的角度解决内存故障问题，通过利用DNN对数值扰动的容忍度，实现了高效率的错误缓解。其核心贡献在于将纠错重心从“精确恢复”转向“范围约束”，在极端错误场景下表现出极强的鲁棒性。
motivation: 随着DRAM密度的增加，多位内存故障日益频繁。由于DNN（特别是LLM）中的注意力层和残差层会放大单点比特翻转带来的极端离群值，导致推理精度严重下降，现有的保护手段难以在高冗余要求下兼顾效率与可靠性。
method: 引入RangeGuard框架，通过编码紧凑的范围标识符（RIDs）来捕获数值范围。在检测到范围偏差时，系统会恢复正确范围并替换为代表值，从而将错误幅度限制在可控范围内。
results: 在仅使用GPU内存中16位奇偶校验位的情况下，RangeGuard能够容忍超过64位比特翻转，且不会导致明显的精度损失。
conclusion: RangeGuard通过引入基于范围标识符（RIDs）的语义保护机制，成功在有限的内存冗余预算下，实现了对深度神经网络（特别是LLM）在多位内存错误下的鲁棒性保护，且几乎没有准确度损失。

title: Open-Source Image Editing Models Are Zero-Shot Vision Learners
authors: Wei Liu, Jiaxin Lin, Rui Chen
abstract:
Recent studies have shown that large generative models can solve vision tasks they were not explicitly trained for. However, existing evidence relies on closed-source models~(Veo~3, Nano Banana Pro) or requires task-specific instruction tuning, leaving open whether publicly available image-editing models possess zero-shot vision abilities out of the box.
  We conduct a systematic evaluation of three open-source image-editing models -- Qwen-Image-Edit, FireRed-Image-Edit, and LongCat-Image-Edit -- on dense visual prediction tasks \emph{without any fine-tuning}. We benchmark monocular depth estimation on NYUv2 and DIODE, surface normal estimation on NYUv2, and semantic segmentation on Cityscapes, covering both geometric and semantic scene understanding.
  Results show that open-source image-editing models exhibit non-trivial zero-shot visual understanding. On NYUv2 surface normals, FireRed-Image-Edit achieves a mean angular error of $17.69^\circ$, surpassing the fine-tuned Marigold ($20.86^\circ$) and matching the instruction-tuned Vision Banana ($17.78^\circ$) without any task-specific training. On NYUv2 depth estimation, LongCat-Image-Edit obtains $δ_1{=}0.822$ with affine alignment, and Qwen-Image-Edit leads on DIODE Indoor ($δ_1{=}0.868$). On Cityscapes semantic segmentation, Qwen-Image-Edit reaches 25.7 mIoU at the 19-class level and 49.5 mIoU at a coarser 7-category level. By comparing three independently trained editors, we test whether zero-shot vision ability is an emergent property of image-editing pretraining rather than a model-specific artifact. Code, evaluation scripts, and all results are publicly released to serve as a reproducible baseline for future work.

title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
authors: Jonathan Spieler, Sven Behnke
abstract: State-of-the-art model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches either use gradient-free, population-based methods for planning, learned policy networks, or a combination of policy networks and planning. Hybrid approaches that combine Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a learned model and a policy prior to leverage the advantages of both paradigms have shown promising results. However, these approaches typically rely on gradient-free optimization methods, which can be computationally expensive for high-dimensional control tasks. While gradient-based methods are a promising alternative, recent works have empirically shown that gradient-based methods often perform worse than their gradient-free counterparts. We propose Dream-MPC, a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions. Our results on 24 continuous control tasks show that Dream-MPC can significantly improve the performance of the underlying policy and can outperform gradient-free MPC and state-of-the-art baselines. We will open source our code and more at https://dream-mpc.github.io.
zh_title: Dream-MPC：基于隐空间想象的梯度模型预测控制
translation: 最先进的基于模型的强化学习（RL）方法通常使用基于种群的无梯度规划方法、学习策略网络，或策略网络与规划的结合。结合模型预测控制（MPC）、学习模型和策略先验的混合方法已经显示出良好的结果。然而，这些方法通常依赖于无梯度优化方法，这对于高维控制任务来说计算成本很高。虽然基于梯度的方法是一个有前途的替代方案，但最近的研究实证表明，基于梯度的方法的表现往往不如无梯度的方法。我们提出了 Dream-MPC，这是一种新颖的方法，它从展开的策略中生成少数候选轨迹，并通过利用学习到的世界模型、不确定性正则化以及通过重用先前优化的动作来平摊随时间变化的优化迭代，对每条轨迹进行梯度上升优化。我们在 24 项连续控制任务上的结果表明，Dream-MPC 可以显著提高基础策略的性能，并且可以优于无梯度 MPC 和最先进的基准。我们将开源代码及更多信息发布在 https://dream-mpc.github.io。
tldr: Dream-MPC 通过将梯度优化与隐空间想象结合，并配合不确定性正则化与动作复用，提升了模型预测控制在复杂任务中的效率与性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将梯度优化引入到基于隐空间想象的MPC中，通过结合策略先验、不确定性正则化和动作重用，有效解决了梯度方法在复杂控制任务中表现不佳的问题，为模型预测控制提供了一种高效且高性能的新范式。
motivation: 现有的基于MPC的强化学习方法多依赖计算昂贵的无梯度优化，而现有的梯度优化方法在复杂任务中表现往往不如无梯度法，缺乏高效的梯度利用机制。
method: 提出 Dream-MPC：通过策略生成少量候选轨迹，利用学习到的世界模型进行梯度上升优化，引入不确定性正则化，并通过复用历史优化动作来平摊计算成本。
results: 在24项连续控制任务中，Dream-MPC显著提升了基础策略的性能，并优于现有的无梯度MPC方法及其他SOTA基准。
conclusion: Dream-MPC 通过结合梯度优化与隐空间想象，在连续控制任务中展现了优于现有梯度法和无梯度法MPC的性能，验证了该方案的高效性。

title: From Parameter Dynamics to Risk Scoring : Quantifying Sample-Level Safety Degradation in LLM Fine-tuning
authors: Xiao Wang, Yifei Zhang, YongKang Liu, Xiaocui Yang, Zihan Wang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang
abstract: Safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is extremely fragile, as fine-tuning on a small number of benign samples can erase safety behaviors learned from millions of preference examples. Existing studies attempt to explain this phenomenon by comparing parameters and hidden states before and after fine-tuning, but overlook their dynamic evolution during fine-tuning. In this paper, we uncover a critical mechanism underlying safety degradation by analyzing parameter dynamics, where benign fine-tuning causes parameters to cumulatively drift toward danger-aligned directions, progressively undermining the model's safety. This finding suggests that samples contributing more to this drift has greater fine-tuning risks. Based on this insight, we propose a method of Sample-Level Quantification of Safety Degradation (SQSD), which quantifies the influence of each training sample on safety degradation. Specifically, SQSD computes continuous risk scores to samples by measuring their induced parameter updates' projection difference between danger and safety directions. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that SQSD effectively quantifies sample-level fine-tuning risks and exhibits strong transferability across model architectures, parameter scales, and parameter-efficient methods.
zh_title: 从参数动态到风险评分：量化大语言模型微调中的样本级安全性退化
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐极其脆弱，因为在少量良性样本上的微调可能会抹除从数百万偏好示例中学到的安全行为。现有的研究试图通过比较微调前后的参数和隐藏状态来解释这种现象，但忽略了它们在微调过程中的动态演化。在本文中，我们通过分析参数动态揭示了安全性退化的关键机制，即良性微调导致参数累积地向危险对齐方向漂移，从而逐步削弱模型的安全性。这一发现表明，对这种漂移贡献更大的样本具有更大的微调风险。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种样本级安全退化量化方法（SQSD），用于量化每个训练样本对安全性退化的影响。具体而言，SQSD通过测量样本诱导的参数更新在危险方向和安全方向上的投影差异，为样本计算连续的风险评分。在多个模型和数据集上的广泛实验表明，SQSD有效地量化了样本级的微调风险，并在模型架构、参数规模和参数高效方法中表现出强大的迁移能力。
tldr: 本文揭示了微调过程中参数向危险方向漂移会导致LLM安全性退化，并提出了一种名为SQSD的方法来量化训练样本的安全风险。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地从参数动态演化的视角解释了LLM微调中的安全性退化现象，而非仅仅关注静态参数变化。提出了一种可量化的风险评分方法（SQSD），不仅具有理论深度，而且在模型架构和训练方法上展现出良好的通用性，为提高微调过程的安全性提供了实用工具。
motivation: 现有研究在分析LLM微调导致安全性退化时，多关注微调前后的静态参数或隐藏状态，忽视了微调过程中的动态演化。作者旨在揭示参数动态变化如何导致模型安全性被逐步破坏，并据此量化微调样本的潜在风险。
method: 提出了一种样本级安全退化量化方法（SQSD）。该方法通过计算训练样本引起的参数更新在危险方向和安全方向上的投影差异，为每个训练样本分配连续的风险评分，以识别导致安全性退化的关键样本。
results: 研究发现，良性样本的微调会导致模型参数累积性地向危险对齐方向漂移，从而削弱模型安全性。基于此设计的SQSD方法能够准确量化样本的微调风险。
conclusion: 实验证明，SQSD能够有效量化微调样本带来的安全风险，且具有跨模型架构、参数规模和参数高效微调方法的强迁移能力。

title: PINSIGHT: A Comprehensive Threat Exploration of Domain-Adaptive Wi-Fi based PIN Code Inference
authors: Johannes Kortz, Paul Staat, Christof Paar, Christian Zenger
abstract: Wi-Fi signals can be exploited by adversaries as a sensing side channel to eavesdrop on physical information. By monitoring propagation effects of radio waves within the victim's environment, attackers can remotely infer sensitive information. One particularly concerning example is PIN code inference, where the attacker faces the challenge of mapping Wi-Fi physical-layer channel estimations back into typed digits. While effective in their training environment, such attacks typically fail as soon as they are deployed in unseen environments. The current state-of-the-art attack, WiKI-Eve, attempts to overcome this problem using a deep-learning approach, reporting high PIN code inference accuracy independent of environments, devices, and users. While this suggests a significant real-world threat, it is not well understood how far the attack actually reaches, nor what its underlying generalization performance is based on. In this work, we close this gap by presenting PINSIGHT, a novel methodology that separates the effects of environmental variation and PIN code typing. This enables the first rigorous threat assessment of such attacks, evaluating their generalization capabilities and limitations. Our approach leverages a robotic typing platform that produces highly repeatable keystroke events across systematically varied environment changes [...]. This dataset constitutes the first benchmark for environment generalization in Wi-Fi PIN code inference attacks. Evaluating several state-of-the-art methods, we find that attacks generalize reliably across changes in the surrounding environment but degrade substantially when the channel's encoding of typing itself shifts - precisely the condition that defines a realistic attack scenario. We conclude that the reported performance of current state-of-the-art Wi-Fi PIN inference attacks is not representative of the actual real-world threat.
zh_title: PINSIGHT：对基于域自适应Wi-Fi的PIN码窃听攻击的全面威胁探索
translation: Wi-Fi信号可被攻击者利用作为物理信息窃听的传感侧信道。通过监控目标环境中无线电波的传播效应，攻击者可以远程推断敏感信息。PIN码窃听是一个特别令人担忧的例子，攻击者面临着将Wi-Fi物理层信道估计映射回已输入数字的挑战。尽管这些攻击在训练环境中有效，但一旦部署到未知环境，它们通常会失效。目前最先进的攻击方法WiKI-Eve试图使用深度学习方法解决这一问题，并报告了独立于环境、设备和用户的极高PIN码窃听准确率。虽然这表明存在重大的现实威胁，但人们并不清楚这种攻击的实际范围，也不清楚其底层泛化性能的基础。在这项工作中，我们提出了PINSIGHT，一种将环境变化和PIN码输入效应分离的新颖方法，填补了这一空白。这使得对此类攻击进行首次严谨的威胁评估成为可能，并评估了其泛化能力和局限性。我们的方法利用一个机器人打字平台，在系统性改变的环境下产生高度可重复的击键事件。该数据集构成了Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击中环境泛化的首个基准。通过评估几种最先进的方法，我们发现攻击在周围环境变化时表现可靠，但在信道对输入本身的编码发生偏移时性能大幅下降——这恰恰是定义现实攻击场景的条件。我们得出结论，目前最先进的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击所报告的性能并不能代表实际的现实威胁。
tldr: 通过构建首个环境泛化基准测试，研究揭示了现有的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在真实复杂环境下的实际威胁远低于预期。
ai_comments: 该研究通过科学的实验设计揭示了现有Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在真实环境中的局限性。其创新点在于通过机器人平台构建了首个环境泛化基准数据集，打破了对现有攻击方法泛化能力的盲目乐观，为该领域的后续研究提供了严谨的评估框架。
motivation: 现有Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击（如WiKI-Eve）声称具有跨环境的鲁棒性，但对其泛化性能的真实边界及底层机制缺乏深入理解，亟需对其进行严谨的威胁评估。
method: 提出PINSIGHT方法，通过机器人打字平台生成具有高度可重复性的击键事件，系统性地分离环境变化和PIN码输入特征，从而评估攻击方法的泛化能力与局限性。
results: 研究发现，虽然攻击在环境变化下表现稳定，但当击键的信号编码方式发生偏移时，攻击性能会显著下降，证明了其在现实攻击场景下的脆弱性。
conclusion: 现有最先进的Wi-Fi PIN码窃听攻击在现实环境中的性能被高估，其实际泛化能力在面临输入方式变化时会大幅下降，无法实现真正的环境无关性。

title: Mixed Finite Elements for Geometrically Exact Beams using Discontinuous Rotations and Discrete Curvature
authors: Alexander Humer, Ivo Steinbrecher, Astrid Pechstein
abstract: We propose a novel mixed finite-element formulation for geometrically exact (Simo--Reissner) beams that introduces the moment vector as additional independent field. The specific mixed form allows for an element-local, discontinuous approximation of rotations, which is key to a simple and efficient discretization framework. The concept of discrete curvature provides a mathematically consistent treatment of rotation discontinuities. For linear constitutive laws, the mixed form is derived via a Legendre transform of the curvature-related strain energy. Objectivity is retained at the discrete level by interpolating relative rotations through a multiplicative split of the rotation field; path-independence is inherent to the total Lagrangian setting and verified numerically. Several benchmarks demonstrate optimal rates of convergence and accuracy, irrespective of the beam's slenderness and order of approximation. Notably, the lowest-order element entirely avoids rotation interpolation by employing element-constant rotations only.
zh_title: 基于非连续旋转和离散曲率的几何精确梁混合有限元法
translation: 我们提出了一种针对几何精确（Simo--Reissner）梁的新型混合有限元公式，引入力矩矢量作为额外的独立场。这种特定的混合形式允许对旋转进行单元局部的、非连续的近似，这是实现简单高效离散化框架的关键。离散曲率的概念为旋转不连续性提供了数学上一致的处理方法。对于线性本构定律，混合形式是通过曲率相关应变能的Legendre变换导出的。通过旋转场的乘法分解插值相对旋转，在离散层面上保持了客观性；路径独立性在全拉格朗日设置中是固有的，并已通过数值验证。多个基准测试证明了最优的收敛率和精度，且不受梁的长细比和近似阶数的影响。值得注意的是，最低阶单元通过仅使用单元常数旋转，完全避免了旋转插值。
tldr: 提出了一种新的混合有限元框架，通过非连续旋转和离散曲率简化了几何精确梁的计算，在保持高精度的同时简化了低阶单元的实现。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入离散曲率和非连续旋转，简化了几何精确梁模型的离散化过程，尤其是在低阶单元中完全避免了复杂的旋转插值，具有很高的计算效率和鲁棒性。
motivation: 旨在解决传统几何精确梁有限元模型在旋转场插值和处理复杂几何非线性时的复杂性与计算效率问题。
method: 提出一种新的混合有限元公式，将力矩矢量作为独立的辅助场，采用单元内非连续的旋转近似，并利用离散曲率处理旋转不连续性，通过Legendre变换导出线性本构关系，并采用乘法分解保持客观性。
results: 数值算例表明该方法具有最优的收敛速度和精度，能够处理不同长细比的梁，且最低阶单元成功实现了无需旋转插值的计算。
conclusion: 提出的混合有限元方法能有效处理几何精确梁，具备最优收敛率，且在各种长细比下均表现稳定，尤其在简化低阶计算方面具有显著优势。

title: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention
authors: Shitong Shao, Zikai Zhou, Haopeng Li, Yingwei Song, Wenliang Zhong, Lichen Bai, Zeke Xie
abstract: Video editing has evolved toward In-Context Learning (ICL) paradigms, yet the resulting quadratic attention costs create a critical computational bottleneck. In this work, we propose In-context Sparse Attention (ISA), the first near-lossless empirical sparse framework tailored for ICL video editing. Our design is grounded in two key insights: first, context tokens exhibit significantly lower saliency than source tokens; second, we theoretically prove and empirically validate that Query sharpness correlates with approximation error. Motivated by these findings, ISA implements an efficient pre-selection strategy to prune redundant context, followed by a dynamic query grouping mechanism that routes high-error queries to full attention and low-error ones to a computationally efficient 0-th order Taylor sparse attention. Furthermore, we build \textbf{\texttt{LIVEditor}} , a novel lightning video editing model via ISA and a proposed video-editing data pipeline that curated a 1.7M high-quality dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIVEditor achieves a $\sim$60% reduction in attention-module latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench, delivering near-lossless acceleration without compromising visual fidelity.
zh_title: 通过上下文稀疏注意力实现闪电般快速的视频编辑
translation: 视频编辑正朝着上下文学习（ICL）范式发展，然而由此产生的二次注意力成本造成了严重的计算瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出了上下文稀疏注意力（ISA），这是第一个专为 ICL 视频编辑定制的近乎无损的经验稀疏框架。我们的设计基于两个关键见解：首先，上下文标记的显著性明显低于源标记；其次，我们从理论上证明并经验性地验证了查询锐度与近似误差相关。受这些发现的启发，ISA 实施了一种高效的预筛选策略来剪枝冗余上下文，随后采用动态查询分组机制，将高误差查询路由到全注意力，将低误差查询路由到计算高效的 0 阶泰勒稀疏注意力。此外，我们构建了 LIVEditor，这是一种通过 ISA 和所提出的视频编辑数据流水线（策划了 1.7M 高质量数据集）实现的新型闪电视频编辑模型。大量实验表明，LIVEditor 在注意力模块延迟方面实现了约 60% 的降低，同时在 EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench 和 VIE-Bench 上超越了最先进的方法，在不损害视觉保真度的情况下提供了近乎无损的加速。
tldr: LIVEditor 引入了一种新的稀疏注意力机制，在保持高质量视频编辑效果的同时，将注意力模块的计算延迟降低了约 60%。
ai_comments: 该论文通过理论推导（查询锐度与近似误差的关系）与工程优化（稀疏注意力机制）的结合，有效解决了视频编辑中上下文学习带来的计算瓶颈。其创新点在于将注意力机制动态化，在大幅降低计算延迟的同时保持了视觉质量，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的基于上下文学习（ICL）的视频编辑方法面临二次注意力计算成本极高的瓶颈，限制了其在大规模应用中的效率。
method: 提出了一种名为上下文稀疏注意力（ISA）的框架，包含上下文预筛选策略和动态查询分组机制（将高误差查询进行全注意力计算，低误差查询使用 0 阶泰勒稀疏注意力），并构建了 LIVEditor 模型及 1.7M 的高质量训练数据集。
results: LIVEditor 在注意力模块延迟上实现了约 60% 的降低，并在多个基准测试（EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench、VIE-Bench）中超越了现有先进方法，且视觉保真度几乎无损失。
conclusion: LIVEditor 通过引入 ISA 机制，成功实现了视频编辑在保持高质量的同时大幅降低计算开销，为高效视频生成模型的发展提供了新思路。

title: VL-UniTrack: A Unified Framework with Visual-Language Prompts for UAV-Ground Visual Tracking
authors: Boyue Xu, Ruichao Hou, Tongwei Ren, Gangshan Wu
abstract: UAV-ground visual tracking (UGVT) aims to simultaneously track the same object from both the UAV and the ground view. However, existing two-stream methods suffer from isolated feature extraction and rely heavily on implicit appearance matching, which struggles to establish reliable correspondence under drastic view differences, leading to tracking unreliability. To address these limitations, we propose VL-UniTrack, a fully unified framework enhanced by visual-language prompts. By encoding features from both views within a single shared encoder, our method breaks the barrier of feature isolation to facilitate sufficient cross-view interaction. To overcome the ambiguity caused by relying solely on appearance matching, we design visual-language geometric prompting module, which fuses language descriptions with visual features to generate learnable prompts. These prompts are then fed into our prompt-guided cross-view adapter module to enable sufficient cross-view feature interaction and to guide the learning of view-specific feature representations. Furthermore, a confidence-modulated mutual distillation loss is proposed to regularize the training by mitigating noise propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the latest benchmark. The code can be downloaded in https://github.com/xuboyue1999/VL-UniTrack.git
zh_title: VL-UniTrack：用于无人机-地面视觉跟踪的视觉-语言提示统一框架
translation: 无人机-地面视觉跟踪 (UGVT) 旨在同时从无人机和地面视角跟踪同一目标。然而，现有的双流方法存在特征提取孤立的问题，且过度依赖隐式外观匹配，在巨大的视角差异下难以建立可靠的对应关系，导致跟踪不可靠。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 VL-UniTrack，这是一个由视觉-语言提示增强的完全统一框架。通过在单个共享编码器中编码来自两个视角的特征，我们的方法打破了特征隔离的障碍，以促进充分的跨视角交互。为了克服仅依赖外观匹配引起的歧义，我们设计了视觉-语言几何提示模块，该模块将语言描述与视觉特征融合以生成可学习的提示。这些提示随后被输入到我们的提示引导的跨视角适配器模块中，以实现充分的跨视角特征交互并指导视角特定特征表示的学习。此外，我们提出了一种置信度调制的互蒸馏损失，通过减轻噪声传播来规范化训练。大量实验表明，我们的方法在最新基准测试上达到了最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/xuboyue1999/VL-UniTrack.git 下载。
tldr: VL-UniTrack通过视觉-语言提示和统一的跨视角适配器，显著提升了无人机与地面视角下目标跟踪的鲁棒性和精度。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了视觉-语言提示（Visual-Language Prompts）来解决无人机-地面视角差异带来的跟踪难题，将多模态信息融合引入到视觉跟踪任务中，具有很高的研究价值和实际应用意义。
motivation: 现有的无人机-地面视觉跟踪方法存在跨视角特征提取隔离、依赖隐式外观匹配导致在巨大视角差异下跟踪不可靠的问题。
method: 提出VL-UniTrack框架，采用共享编码器消除特征隔离；设计视觉-语言几何提示模块融合语义信息；引入提示引导的跨视角适配器模块进行交互；使用置信度调制的互蒸馏损失函数优化训练。
results: 在最新基准测试中表现优异，实现了最先进的跟踪性能。
conclusion: VL-UniTrack通过统一的框架和视觉-语言提示机制，有效解决了跨视角特征隔离和外观匹配模糊的问题，在UAV-地面跟踪任务中达到了最先进的性能。

title: GTF: Omnidirectional EPI Transformer for Light Field Super-Resolution
authors: Kunyu Li, Fei Wang, Lichao Zhang, Junjie Liu, Bihong Li
abstract: Light field (LF) image super-resolution benefits from Epipolar Plane Images (EPIs), whose line slopes explicitly encode disparity. However, existing Transformer-based LF SR methods mainly attend to horizontal and vertical EPIs, leaving diagonal epipolar geometry underexplored. We present GTF, an omnidirectional EPI Transformer that explicitly models horizontal, vertical, 45-degree, and 135-degree EPIs within a unified reconstruction framework. GTF combines directional EPI processing, MacPI-based prior injection, adaptive directional fusion, and a topology-preserving feed-forward network to better exploit LF geometry. For the NTIRE 2026 fidelity tracks, we use GTF as the main model, while a lightweight GTF-Tiny variant targets the efficiency track. On five standard LF SR benchmarks covering both real-captured and synthetic scenes, GTF reaches 32.78 dB without inference-time enhancement, and stronger inference settings with EPSW and test-time augmentation further improve performance. Under the NTIRE 2026 efficiency constraint, GTF-Tiny attains 32.57 dB with only 0.915M parameters and 19.81 GFLOPs. In the NTIRE 2026 Light Field Image Super-Resolution Challenge, our submissions rank 3rd on Track 1 and Track 3 and 4th on Track 2. Architecture-evolution, channel-width, and inference analyses further support the effectiveness of diagonal EPI modeling, directional fusion, and the lightweight design.

title: Benchmarking POS Tagging for the Tajik Language: A Comparative Study of Neural Architectures on the TajPersParallel Corpus
authors: Mullosharaf K. Arabov
abstract:
This paper presents the first benchmark for the task of automatic part-of-speech (POS) tagging for the Tajik language. Despite the existence of multilingual language models demonstrating high effectiveness for many of the world's languages, their capacity for grammatical analysis of Tajik has remained unexplored until now. The aim of this study is to fill this gap through a systematic comparison of classical neural network architectures and modern multilingual transformers.
  Experiments were conducted on the TajPersParallel corpus, a parallel lexical resource comprising approximately 44,000 dictionary entries. Due to the absence of full-fledged example sentences in the current version of the corpus, the task was performed at the level of isolated lexical units, representing a challenging case of context-independent classification. The study compares the following architectures: a recurrent BiLSTM-CRF model, as well as multilingual models XLM-RoBERTa (large), mBERT, ParsBERT (Persian), and ruBERT (Russian), adapted using the parameter-efficient fine-tuning method LoRA.
  The testing results showed that the best performance is achieved by the mBERT + LoRA model (macro F1-score = 0.11, weighted F1-score = 0.62). It was established that in the absence of syntactic context, all models experience significant difficulty in resolving morphological ambiguity, successfully classifying primarily high-frequency classes ("noun," "adjective") while demonstrating zero effectiveness for rare function words. Zero-shot evaluation revealed the greatest typological proximity of Tajik to Persian (ParsBERT) and Russian (ruBERT). The obtained results form a foundation for further research and development in the field of automatic processing of the Tajik language.
zh_title: 塔吉克语词性标注基准测试：基于TajPersParallel语料库的神经架构对比研究
translation: 本文提出了塔吉克语自动词性标注（POS）任务的第一个基准。尽管多语言语言模型在许多世界语言中表现出高效，但它们对塔吉克语语法分析的能力此前一直未被探索。本研究旨在通过系统比较经典神经网络架构和现代多语言Transformer来填补这一空白。实验在TajPersParallel语料库上进行，这是一个包含约44,000个词典条目的平行词汇资源。由于当前版本的语料库缺乏完整的例句，任务是在孤立词汇单元层面执行的，这代表了上下文无关分类的一个挑战性案例。研究比较了以下架构：循环BiLSTM-CRF模型，以及使用参数高效微调方法LoRA适配的多语言模型XLM-RoBERTa (large)、mBERT、ParsBERT（波斯语）和ruBERT（俄语）。测试结果表明，mBERT + LoRA模型取得了最佳性能（宏F1分数=0.11，加权F1分数=0.62）。研究确定，在缺乏句法上下文的情况下，所有模型在解决形态歧义方面都经历了重大困难，主要成功分类了高频类别（“名词”、“形容词”），而对稀有功能词的有效性为零。零样本评估揭示了塔吉克语与波斯语（ParsBERT）和俄语（ruBERT）在类型学上的最大接近度。所得结果为塔吉克语自动处理领域的进一步研究和开发奠定了基础。
tldr: 本文首次对塔吉克语词性标注进行了基准研究，发现mBERT+LoRA模型效果最佳，但也揭示了在缺乏上下文的情况下模型处理形态歧义的局限性。
ai_comments: 该研究是塔吉克语词性标注的首个基准测试，具有开创性意义。其局限在于语料库缺乏句子上下文，导致分类任务在孤立词汇层面进行，模型表现受限，特别是对稀有功能词的识别能力较弱。
motivation: 填补塔吉克语自动词性标注研究的空白，探索多语言模型在塔吉克语语法分析中的有效性。
method: 在TajPersParallel语料库上对BiLSTM-CRF、XLM-RoBERTa、mBERT、ParsBERT和ruBERT等模型进行对比实验，并采用LoRA进行参数高效微调。
results: mBERT + LoRA模型表现最佳（加权F1分数为0.62）。所有模型在处理形态歧义和稀有功能词时均面临显著困难。零样本评估显示塔吉克语与波斯语和俄语最为接近。
conclusion: 研究确立了塔吉克语词性标注的基准，指出在缺乏上下文的情况下模型性能受限，并证实了塔吉克语与波斯语和俄语在语言学上的紧密关联。

title: IntenBot: Flexible and Imprecise Multimodal Input for LLMs to Understand User Intentions for Casual and Human-Like HRI
authors: Yen-Ting Liu, Chiu-Hsuan Wang, TzuLing Chen, Ting-Ying Lee, Tzu-Hua Wang, Chien-Ming Lin, Bing-Yu Chen, Hsin-Ruey Tsai
abstract: In natural human-to-human communication, multimodal user input is typically used to supplement explicit and complement implicit voice commands, with casualness allowing for flexible input modality combinations and tolerance for imprecise input data. For example, saying "I want that." with a casual glance at a bottle of water is clear enough in human-to-human communication as an implicit voice command accompanied by gaze and/or gestures, rather than an explicit one. To enable such a human-like interaction in human-robot interaction (HRI), we propose a system, IntenBot, to understand user intentions from flexible and imprecise multimodal input, including voice, gaze, and finger-pointing, in XR. The disambiguation capability of large language models (LLMs) is used to filter out irrelevant input modalities and imprecise input data, generating potential instructions for user confirmation. The flexible and imprecise multimodal input enables casual, human-like interaction with robots, reducing time, effort, and attention, and could also be used as non-voice input. We conducted an informative user behavior study in a simulated environment to understand users' natural be- havior in flexibly interacting with a robot using multimodal input and to obtain appropriate angle range parameters for gaze and finger-pointing. An XR study was then performed to evaluate the performance of IntenBot, compared with other methods. We also deployed IntenBot on a physical robot to showcase its real-world applications.

title: From Diffusion to Rectified Flow: Rethinking Text-Based Segmentation
authors: Zishen Qu, Xuesong Li, Haijian Gu, Hongwei Kang, Quan Meng, Tianrui Niu, Xin Yang, Ruidong Pan
abstract: Text-based image segmentation aims to delineate object boundaries within an image from text prompts, offering higher flexibility and broader application scope compared to traditional fixed-category segmentation tasks. Recent studies have shown that diffusion models (e.g., Stable Diffusion) can provide rich multimodal semantic features, leading to studies of using diffusion models as feature extractors for segmentation tasks. Such methods, however, inherit the generative natures of diffusion models that are harmful to discriminative segmentation tasks. In response, we propose RLFSeg, a novel framework that leverages Rectified Flow to learn direct mapping from the image to the segmentation mask within the latent space. The model is thus freed from the noise-denoise process and the need to optimize the time step of diffusion models, resulting in substantially better performance than previous diffusion-based methods, especially on zero-shot scenarios. By introducing label refinement and an Adaptive One-Step Sampling strategy, the model achieves higher accuracy even on a single inference step. The framework redirects a pretrained generative model to the discriminative segmentation task with zero modification to model structure, thus reveals promising application potential and significant research value.
zh_title: 从扩散模型到Rectified Flow：对基于文本的图像分割的再思考
translation: 基于文本的图像分割旨在根据文本提示勾勒图像中的物体边界，与传统的固定类别分割任务相比，它提供了更高的灵活性和更广的应用范围。最近的研究表明，扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）可以提供丰富的多模态语义特征，从而引发了将扩散模型用作分割任务特征提取器的研究。然而，这些方法继承了扩散模型的生成特性，这对判别式的分割任务是有害的。为此，我们提出了RLFSeg，这是一个新颖的框架，利用Rectified Flow在潜在空间内学习从图像到分割掩码的直接映射。该模型因此摆脱了噪声-去噪过程以及优化扩散模型时间步长的需求，在零样本场景下表现出远超以往基于扩散模型的方法的性能。通过引入标签精炼和自适应单步采样策略，该模型即使在单步推理下也能实现更高的精度。该框架在不对模型结构进行任何修改的情况下，将预训练的生成模型重定向到判别式分割任务，展示了广阔的应用潜力和重要的研究价值。
tldr: RLFSeg通过将扩散模型重构为Rectified Flow，去除了冗余的去噪过程，实现了更高效、更准确的零样本文本驱动图像分割。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将生成式模型转化为判别式任务，巧妙地规避了扩散模型中去噪过程的冗余性，是多模态学习领域的一个重要范式转变。其创新之处在于利用Rectified Flow将复杂的生成过程简化为直接映射，显著提升了推理速度与零样本分割性能。
motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的分割方法继承了扩散模型生成式的特性，其去噪过程对判别式分割任务是不利的，且需要优化时间步长，效率较低。
method: 提出了RLFSeg框架，利用Rectified Flow学习从图像到分割掩码的直接映射；引入了标签精炼（label refinement）和自适应单步采样（Adaptive One-Step Sampling）策略。
results: 相比现有的基于扩散模型的方法，RLFSeg在零样本场景下表现更佳，且在单步推理下即可实现高精度分割。
conclusion: RLFSeg框架通过将扩散模型重构为Rectified Flow，成功实现了高效、高精度的零样本文本语义分割，证明了预训练生成模型在判别任务中的巨大潜力。

title: TajikNLP: An Open-Source Toolkit for Comprehensive Text Processing of Tajik (Cyrillic Script)
authors: Mullosharaf K. Arabov
abstract: The Tajik language, written in Cyrillic script, remains severely under-resourced in terms of publicly available natural language processing (NLP) toolkits, hindering both linguistic research and applied development. This paper introduces TajikNLP, an open-source Python library that provides the first comprehensive pipeline for processing authentic Tajik text while preserving the original Cyrillic orthography. The library implements a modular architecture centered around a unified Doc object, enabling sequential application of components for cleaning, normalization, tokenization (including subword BPE), morphemic segmentation, part-of-speech tagging, stemming, lemmatization, and sentence splitting. A novel unified morphology engine is introduced, offering controlled and deep analysis modes that significantly improve handling of Tajik's agglutinative nominal and verbal inflections. The release further incorporates a lexicon-based sentiment analyser and pre-trained Word2Vec/FastText embeddings loaded directly from the Hugging Face Hub. To ensure reproducibility and facilitate future research, four accompanying linguistic datasets -- a POS-tagged corpus (52.5k entries), a sentiment lexicon (3.5k entries), a toponym gazetteer (5.6k entries), and a personal names dataset (3.8k entries) -- have been openly published under permissive licenses. The library's reliability is validated by an extensive test suite of 616 automated tests achieving 93% source code coverage. TajikNLP thus establishes a foundational technological infrastructure for Tajik language processing, lowering the barrier to entry for both academic and industrial applications in low-resource Cyrillic-script environments.
zh_title: TajikNLP：一个用于塔吉克语（西里尔字母）综合文本处理的开源工具包
translation: 塔吉克语（使用西里尔字母书写）在公开可用的自然语言处理（NLP）工具包方面仍然严重缺乏资源，这阻碍了语言学研究和应用开发。本文介绍了TajikNLP，这是一个开源的Python库，它提供了第一个用于处理真实塔吉克语文本的综合管线，同时保留了原始的西里尔字母拼写。该库实现了一个以统一Doc对象为中心的模块化架构，能够按顺序应用清洗、归一化、分词（包括子词BPE）、词素分割、词性标注、词干提取、词形还原和句子拆分等组件。文中引入了一种新颖的统一形态引擎，提供受控和深度分析模式，显著改善了对塔吉克语黏着名词和动词屈折变化的处理。该版本还整合了一个基于词典的情感分析器，并直接从Hugging Face Hub加载预训练的Word2Vec/FastText嵌入。为了确保可重复性并促进未来研究，四个配套的语言学数据集——一个词性标注语料库（52.5k条目）、一个情感词典（3.5k条目）、一个地名地名录（5.6k条目）和一个个人姓名数据集（3.8k条目）——已在许可协议下公开。该库的可靠性通过包含616个自动化测试的广泛测试套件进行了验证，实现了93%的源代码覆盖率。因此，TajikNLP为塔吉克语处理建立了基础的技术基础设施，降低了低资源西里尔字母环境下学术和工业应用的准入门槛。
tldr: TajikNLP是首个针对塔吉克语的全面开源NLP工具包，提供了包括形态分析在内的完整处理流程及配套数据集，有效解决了塔吉克语NLP资源匮乏的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了塔吉克语在NLP工具包方面的空白，通过提供一套完整的处理管线和开源数据集，显著降低了该低资源语言的研究门槛。其模块化设计和对塔吉克语黏着语特性的针对性优化（如统一形态引擎）具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。
motivation: 塔吉克语（西里尔字母）在自然语言处理工具方面资源极度匮乏，严重阻碍了相关的语言学研究与应用开发。
method: 开发了一个基于Python的模块化NLP库，采用统一的Doc对象架构；引入了针对塔吉克语黏着语特性的统一形态引擎；集成了情感分析器和预训练词向量；并发布了四个配套的语言学数据集。
results: TajikNLP成功实现了包括分词、词性标注、形态分析、词干提取等在内的全流程文本处理，代码测试覆盖率达93%，并开源了四个关键的语言学数据集。
conclusion: TajikNLP 为塔吉克语处理提供了一个全面、可靠且开源的基础架构，极大地促进了该语言在学术研究和工业应用中的发展。

title: DiCLIP: Diffusion Model Enhances CLIP's Dense Knowledge for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
authors: Zhiwei Yang, Pengfei Song, Yucong Meng, Kexue Fu, Shuo Wang, Zhijian Song
abstract: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) with image-level labels typically leverages Class Activation Maps (CAMs) to achieve pixel-level predictions. Recently, Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been introduced to generate CAMs in WSSS. However, previous WSSS methods solely adopt CLIP's vision-language paired property for dense localization, neglecting its inherently limited dense knowledge across both visual and text modalities, which renders CAM generation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DiCLIP, a novel WSSS framework that leverages the generative diffusion model to enhance CLIP's dense knowledge across two modalities. Specifically, Visual Correlation Enhancement (VCE) and Text Semantic Augmentation (TSA) modules are proposed for dense prediction enhancement. To improve the spatial awareness of visual features, our VCE module utilizes diffusion's reliable spatial consistency to mitigate the over-smoothing issue in CLIP's attention. It designs the Attention Clustering Refinement (ACR) module to reliably extract diverse correlation maps from the diffusion model. The correlation maps act as a diversity bias for CLIP's self-attention, recursively pushing its visual features towards a more discriminative dense distribution. To augment the semantics of text embeddings, our TSA module argues that a single text modality is insufficient to encompass the variability of visual categories. Thus, we leverage diffusion's generative power to maintain a dynamic key-value cache model, shifting CAM generation from a patch-text matching mechanism to a novel visual knowledge retrieval paradigm. With these enhancements, DiCLIP not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO but also significantly reduces training costs. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/zwyang6/DiCLIP.
comment: This work is accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
zh_title: DiCLIP：扩散模型增强CLIP的密集知识用于弱监督语义分割
translation: 弱监督语义分割（WSSS）通常利用仅包含图像级标签的类激活映射（CAM）来实现像素级的预测。最近，对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）已被引入WSSS以生成CAM。然而，以往的WSSS方法仅采用CLIP的视觉-语言配对属性进行密集定位，忽略了其在视觉和文本模态中固有的有限密集知识，导致CAM生成效果不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了DiCLIP，一个利用生成式扩散模型增强CLIP在两个模态中密集知识的新型WSSS框架。具体而言，我们提出了视觉相关性增强（VCE）和文本语义增强（TSA）模块用于密集预测的增强。为了提高视觉特征的空间感知能力，我们的VCE模块利用扩散模型可靠的空间一致性来缓解CLIP注意力中的过度平滑问题。它设计了注意力聚类细化（ACR）模块，从扩散模型中可靠地提取多样化的相关性图。这些相关性图作为CLIP自注意力的多样性偏差，递归地将视觉特征推向更具判别力的密集分布。为了增强文本嵌入的语义，我们的TSA模块认为单一文本模态不足以涵盖视觉类别的可变性。因此，我们利用扩散模型的生成能力来维护一个动态的键值缓存模型，将CAM生成从补丁-文本匹配机制转变为一种新颖的视觉知识检索范式。通过这些增强，DiCLIP不仅在PASCAL VOC和MS COCO上优于最先进的方法，而且显著降低了训练成本。代码已在 https://github.com/zwyang6/DiCLIP 公开。
tldr: DiCLIP利用扩散模型弥补了CLIP在弱监督语义分割中密集知识的不足，通过增强视觉特征和文本语义，大幅提升了分割精度并降低了训练成本。
ai_comments: DiCLIP通过引入扩散模型来弥补CLIP在弱监督语义分割中密集知识不足的缺陷，这是一个非常新颖且有效的视角。通过VCE和TSA模块，该方法成功改善了特征的空间感知能力和文本语义的丰富度，在提升精度的同时降低了训练成本，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 现有的基于CLIP的弱监督语义分割方法仅利用了其视觉-语言对齐特性，忽略了CLIP在处理密集预测任务时自身知识的局限性，导致类激活映射（CAM）生成效果欠佳。
method: 提出DiCLIP框架，包含两个核心模块：1. 视觉相关性增强（VCE）模块，利用扩散模型的空间一致性解决CLIP注意力的过平滑问题，并通过注意力聚类细化（ACR）提取相关性图；2. 文本语义增强（TSA）模块，利用扩散模型的生成能力维护动态缓存，将CAM生成转变为视觉知识检索范式。
results: DiCLIP在PASCAL VOC和MS COCO数据集上均超越了现有的先进方法，并且在训练成本上有显著降低。
conclusion: DiCLIP通过扩散模型显著增强了CLIP的密集知识，有效解决了弱监督语义分割中CAM生成不佳的问题，在主流基准数据集上取得了领先性能。

title: A Blockchain-as-a-Service Solution for TAFES-Compliant Verification of Fair Trade Certifications
authors: Nadia Dahmani, Peihao Li, Ravi S. Sharma
abstract:
\abstract{\textbf{Purpose:} This study addresses the lack of trust in ethical product labels by designing a blockchain platform grounded in the TAFES principles (Transparency, Accountability, Fairness, Ethics, Safety). It aims to bridge the gap between blockchain's theoretical transparency and a responsible, real-world implementation for certification ecosystems.
  \textbf{Design/Methodology/Approach:} Using Action Design Research, we developed a proof-of-concept platform for label authentication. A hybrid architecture records critical events on an Ethereum Layer-2 network for security, while supporting evidence is stored off-chain via IPFS and linked via content identifiers. The solution was validated through a coffee supply chain scenario.
  \textbf{Findings:} The proof of concept demonstrates how a TAFES-aligned blockchain platform can support verification of label claims without requiring trust in a single intermediary by creating tamper-evident provenance records and auditable certification evidence across multiple stakeholders. The design supports low-cost, near-real-time anchoring of supply chain events while mitigating adoption barriers related to scalability, privacy, and operational viability.
  \textbf{Originality/Value:} This research contributes an integrated ethical and technical blueprint for trustworthy label authentication systems by translating TAFES into implementable design requirements and evaluation checks, and validating them through an ADR driven proof of concept. It advances prior work by moving from the question of whether blockchain can help to the question of how it should be implemented responsibly in multi stakeholder certification ecosystems.}
zh_title: 一种用于TAFES合规公平贸易认证验证的区块链即服务解决方案
translation: 目的：本研究旨在通过设计一个基于TAFES原则（透明度、问责制、公平性、伦理、安全）的区块链平台，解决伦理产品标签缺乏信任的问题。其目标是弥合区块链理论上的透明性与认证生态系统负责任的现实实施之间的差距。设计/方法/路径：利用行动设计研究，我们开发了一个用于标签认证的概念验证平台。该混合架构将关键事件记录在以太坊Layer-2网络上以确保安全，同时通过IPFS在链下存储辅助证据，并通过内容标识符进行链接。该解决方案通过咖啡供应链场景进行了验证。发现：概念验证展示了符合TAFES原则的区块链平台如何通过在多个利益相关者之间创建防篡改的溯源记录和可审计的认证证据，在无需信任单一中介的情况下支持标签声明的验证。该设计支持供应链事件的低成本、近乎实时的锚定，同时减轻了与可扩展性、隐私和运营可行性相关的采用障碍。原创性/价值：本研究通过将TAFES转化为可实施的设计需求和评估检查，并通过ADR驱动的概念验证进行验证，为可信标签认证系统贡献了一个综合的伦理和技术蓝图。它通过从“区块链是否有帮助”的问题转向“如何在多利益相关者认证生态系统中负责任地实施”的问题，推动了先前的研究。
tldr: 本文利用TAFES原则设计了一个区块链平台，通过Layer-2和IPFS技术实现了公平贸易认证的去中心化可信验证，解决了供应链中的信任缺失问题。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将抽象的伦理原则（TAFES）转化为具体的区块链设计需求，并结合Layer-2和IPFS技术解决了实际应用中的性能与隐私痛点。它为伦理认证领域提供了一个务实且可落地的技术架构参考。
motivation: 旨在解决现有伦理产品标签缺乏信任的问题，弥合区块链理论上的透明性与现实中负责任的认证生态系统实施之间的差距。
method: 采用行动设计研究 (Action Design Research) 方法；构建基于以太坊Layer-2网络的混合架构，利用IPFS存储链下证据，并通过咖啡供应链场景进行验证。
results: 开发了一个概念验证平台，实现了低成本、近乎实时的供应链事件锚定；通过防篡改的溯源记录和可审计的证明，成功在无需单一中介的情况下验证了标签声明，并克服了可扩展性和隐私方面的障碍。
conclusion: 本研究成功证明了基于TAFES原则的区块链平台可以实现公平贸易认证的可信验证，通过去中心化的溯源记录消除了对单一中介的依赖，为多方参与的供应链生态系统提供了一种可扩展且负责任的解决方案。

title: A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Stability Analysis of LLM Inference with KV Cache Memory Constraints
authors: Chengyi Nie, Nian Si, Zijie Zhou
abstract: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) has created significant challenges for efficient inference at scale. Unlike traditional workloads, LLM inference is constrained by both computation and the memory overhead of key-value (KV) caching, which accelerates decoding but quickly exhausts GPU memory. In this paper, we introduce the first queueing-theoretic framework that explicitly incorporates both computation and GPU memory constraints into the analysis of LLM inference. Based on this framework, we derive rigorous stability and instability conditions that determine whether an LLM inference service can sustain incoming demand without unbounded queue growth. This result offers a powerful tool for system deployment, potentially addressing the core challenge of GPU provisioning. By combining an estimated request arrival rate with our derived stable service rate, operators can calculate the necessary cluster size to avoid both costly over-purchasing and performance-violating under-provisioning. We further validate our theoretical predictions through extensive experiments in real GPU production environments. Our results show that the predicted stability conditions are highly accurate, with deviations typically within 10%.
zh_title: 基于排队论的LLM推理KV缓存内存约束稳定性分析框架
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速普及为大规模高效推理带来了严峻挑战。与传统工作负载不同，LLM推理同时受到计算能力和键值（KV）缓存内存开销的限制；KV缓存虽然能加速解码，但会迅速耗尽GPU内存。在本文中，我们引入了第一个将计算和GPU内存约束明确纳入LLM推理分析的排队论框架。基于该框架，我们推导出了严格的稳定性和不稳定性条件，以确定LLM推理服务是否能在不导致队列无限增长的情况下承受传入需求。这一结果为系统部署提供了强有力的工具，有望解决GPU配置的核心挑战。通过结合估计的请求到达率与我们导出的稳定服务率，运营商可以计算出必要的集群规模，从而避免昂贵的过度采购和违反性能要求的配置不足。我们进一步通过真实GPU生产环境中的大量实验验证了我们的理论预测。结果表明，预测的稳定性条件非常准确，偏差通常在10%以内。
tldr: 提出了一种分析LLM推理稳定性的排队论框架，考虑了计算与KV缓存约束，能精准预测系统承载能力并指导GPU资源部署。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次利用排队论框架将KV缓存的内存约束与计算约束统一建模，为LLM推理服务的资源规划提供了理论依据。其局限性可能在于对于复杂多变的真实网络流量模型，静态的排队论假设可能需要进一步的动态调整。
motivation: LLM推理不仅受计算能力限制，还受KV缓存带来的巨大内存开销限制，现有系统缺乏有效的理论框架来分析在大规模请求下如何避免系统队列无限制增长。
method: 构建了一个结合计算与GPU内存（KV缓存）约束的排队论模型，推导出系统稳定与不稳定的边界条件，并通过真实GPU生产环境的实验进行验证。
results: 推导出的稳定性条件在真实GPU环境中表现出极高的准确性，预测偏差通常在10%以内，有效支持了集群规模的精准规划。
conclusion: 该研究成功建立了一个能够准确预测LLM推理服务稳定性的排队论框架，为工业界在大规模部署时进行合理的GPU资源配置提供了科学依据。

title: HeterSEED: Semantics-Structure Decoupling for Heterogeneous Graph Learning under Heterophily
authors: Xinyi Li, Ming Li, Lu Bai, Lixin Cui, Feilong Cao, Ke Lv, Yunliang Jiang, Pietro Liò
abstract: Many real-world heterogeneous graphs exhibit pronounced heterophily, where connected nodes often have dissimilar labels or play different semantic roles. In such settings, standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that aggregate messages along metapaths or meta-relations primarily based on feature similarity can propagate misleading information, since feature similarity may be misaligned with underlying relational semantics. In this paper, we propose HeterSEED, a semantics-structure decoupling framework for heterogeneous graph learning under heterophily. HeterSEED decouples representation learning into a heterogeneous semantic channel that captures type- and relation-aware local semantics and a structure-aware heterophily channel that separates homophilic and heterophilic neighborhoods via pseudo-label-guided partitioning and aggregates them using metapath-based structural weights. A node-level adaptive fusion mechanism then combines the two channels to produce context-dependent node representations. Theoretically, we establish that, on heterogeneous graphs under heterophily, HeterSEED is strictly more expressive than standard heterogeneous graph neural networks that rely primarily on feature similarity and provably reduces the prediction bias introduced by heterophilic neighbors. Experiments on five real-world heterogeneous graphs, including two large-scale networks at the million-node and hundred-million-edge scale, demonstrate that HeterSEED consistently outperforms representative heterogeneous graph neural networks and recent heterophily-aware baselines, especially in strongly heterophilic regimes.
zh_title: HeterSEED：异质性场景下异质图学习的语义-结构解耦框架
translation: 许多现实世界的异质图表现出显著的异质性，即相连节点通常具有不同的标签或扮演不同的语义角色。在这种情况下，主要基于特征相似性沿元路径或元关系聚合消息的标准异质图神经网络可能会传播误导性信息，因为特征相似性可能与潜在的关系语义不一致。在本文中，我们提出了 HeterSEED，这是一个用于异质性场景下异质图学习的语义-结构解耦框架。HeterSEED 将表示学习解耦为：一个捕捉类型和关系感知局部语义的异质语义通道；以及一个通过伪标签引导划分同质和异质邻域，并使用基于元路径的结构权重进行聚合的结构感知异质性通道。随后，节点级自适应融合机制结合这两个通道以产生上下文相关的节点表示。从理论上讲，我们证明了在具有异质性的异质图上，HeterSEED 比主要依赖特征相似性的标准异质图神经网络具有更强的表达能力，并可证明能够减少异质邻居引入的预测偏差。在五个真实世界异质图（包括两个百万节点和亿级边的超大规模网络）上的实验表明，HeterSEED 在强异质性环境下始终优于代表性的异质图神经网络和最近的异质性感知基准方法。
tldr: HeterSEED 通过将异质图的语义学习与结构感知解耦，有效解决了异质性图学习中特征相似性带来的误导性信息问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过解耦语义和结构信息，巧妙地解决了异质图在异质性（heterophily）场景下信息传递易受干扰的问题。其理论证明和在大规模数据集上的验证增强了方法的可信度。其局限性可能在于对伪标签的依赖，如果伪标签质量不高，可能会影响整体性能。
motivation: 现有的异质图神经网络在处理具有显著异质性（即相连节点标签或角色不相似）的图时，由于过度依赖特征相似性进行消息传递，导致引入误导性信息。
method: 提出了 HeterSEED 框架，包含三个核心模块：1. 异质语义通道，用于捕捉类型和关系感知的局部语义；2. 结构感知异质性通道，通过伪标签引导将邻居划分为同质和异质部分并进行加权聚合；3. 节点级自适应融合机制，综合两个通道的信息生成最终节点表示。
results: 理论上证明了 HeterSEED 比标准异质图神经网络具有更强的表达能力，并能降低异质邻居引入的预测偏差。实验表明，在五个真实世界数据集（包括大规模网络）上，HeterSEED 的表现优于现有的异质图神经网络和异质性感知基准方法。
conclusion: HeterSEED 通过解耦语义与结构，有效缓解了异质图中的异质性问题，在表达能力和预测准确性上均优于现有的异质图神经网络。

title: Right Model, Right Time: Real-Time Cascaded-Fidelity MPC for Bipedal Walking
authors: Franek Stark, Felix Wiebe, Shubham Vyas, Dennis Mronga, Frank Kirchner
abstract: This paper presents a multi-phase whole-body model predictive control approach for bipedal walking, combining a detailed whole-body model in the near horizon with a simplified single-rigid-body model in the later prediction steps. This reduces computational complexity while retaining prediction capabilities. The resulting nonlinear optimal control problem is solved using sequential quadratic programming (SQP) in acados. Using a prior specified contact schedule and a target walking speed, the controller optimizes joint torques without depending on prior selected foot step locations. The controller is validated in MuJoCo simulation on the 18-DoF bipedal robot HyPer-2
comment: Accepted to IEEE ICRA 2026 Workshop "2cnd Workshop on Frontiers of Optimization for Robotics"
zh_title: 正确的模型，正确的时间：用于双足行走的实时级联保真度模型预测控制
translation: 本文提出了一种用于双足行走的全身模型预测控制方法，该方法在近视界结合了详细的全身模型，并在后续预测步骤中采用了简化的单刚体模型。这种方法在保留预测能力的同时降低了计算复杂度。生成的非线性最优控制问题使用acados中的顺序二次规划（SQP）进行求解。该控制器使用预先指定的接触计划和目标行走速度，在不依赖预先选择的落脚点的情况下优化关节力矩。该控制器已在18自由度的双足机器人HyPer-2的MuJoCo模拟中得到验证。
tldr: 通过结合详尽的全身模型和简化的单刚体模型，实现了一种无需预设落脚点的实时高效双足行走控制方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种级联保真度（Cascaded-Fidelity）的MPC策略，通过在近距离预测时使用高保真全身模型，在远距离预测时使用简化的单刚体模型，巧妙地平衡了计算复杂度和预测精度。这种方法无需预先设定落脚点，增强了双足机器人在复杂环境下的灵活性。
motivation: 解决双足行走控制中计算复杂度与预测精度之间的矛盾，旨在实现无需预设落脚点的实时全身动力学控制。
method: 提出了一种多阶段全身模型预测控制方法，在近视界使用详细全身模型，远视界使用简化单刚体模型；利用acados工具通过顺序二次规划（SQP）求解非线性最优控制问题。
results: 在18自由度的HyPer-2双足机器人MuJoCo模拟器中验证了该控制器的有效性，实现了在给定行走速度下的实时关节力矩优化。
conclusion: 该研究成功验证了一种高效的全身MPC控制器，能够实现无需预设落脚点的实时双足行走控制，为复杂动力学系统的实时控制提供了新思路。

title: Reference-based Category Discovery: Unsupervised Object Detection with Category Awareness
authors: Yichen Li, Qiankun Liu, Ying Fu
abstract: Traditional one-shot detection methods have addressed the closed-set problem in object detection, but the high cost of data annotation remains a critical challenge. General unsupervised methods generate pseudo boxes without category labels, thus failing to achieve category-aware classification. To overcome these limitations, we propose Reference-based Category Discovery (RefCD), an unsupervised detector that enables category-aware\footnotemark[1] detection without any manually annotated labels. It leverages feature similarity between predicted objects and unlabeled reference images. Unlike previous unsupervised methods that lack category guidance and one-shot methods which require labeled data, RefCD introduces a carefully designed feature similarity loss to explicitly guide the learning of potential category-specific features. Additionally, RefCD supports category-agnostic detection without reference images, serving as a unified framework. Comprehensive quantitative and qualitative analysis of category-aware and category-agnostic detection results demonstrates its effectiveness, and RefCD can learn category information in an unsupervised paradigm even without category labels.
zh_title: 基于参考的类别发现：具备类别感知的无监督目标检测
translation: 传统的单样本检测方法解决了目标检测中的封闭集问题，但数据标注的高昂成本仍然是一个关键挑战。一般的无监督方法生成的伪框缺乏类别标签，因此无法实现类别感知分类。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了基于参考的类别发现（RefCD），这是一种无需任何人工标注标签即可实现类别感知检测的无监督检测器。它利用预测对象与未标注参考图像之间的特征相似度。与缺乏类别指导的传统无监督方法以及需要标注数据的单样本方法不同，RefCD 引入了一种精心设计的特征相似度损失，以明确引导潜在类别特定特征的学习。此外，RefCD 作为一个统一框架，还支持无需参考图像的类别无关检测。对类别感知和类别无关检测结果的全面定量和定性分析证明了其有效性，RefCD 即使在没有类别标签的情况下也能以无监督范式学习类别信息。
tldr: RefCD 是一种新型无监督目标检测框架，通过利用参考图像的特征相似度，在无需任何人工标注的情况下实现了类别感知检测。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将参考图像的特征相似度引入无监督目标检测中，填补了现有无监督方法缺乏类别感知能力的空白，且无需人工标注，具有显著的实际应用价值。
motivation: 传统方法面临人工标注成本高昂的问题，而现有的无监督方法虽无需标注却缺乏类别感知能力。
method: 提出 RefCD 框架，利用预测对象与未标注参考图像之间的特征相似度来引导潜在类别特征的学习，并设计了相应的特征相似度损失函数。
results: 实验结果表明，RefCD 有效实现了类别感知检测，并能作为一个统一框架同时支持类别无关的检测任务。
conclusion: RefCD 是一个有效的统一框架，能够在完全无标注的情况下实现类别感知和类别无关的目标检测。

title: SensingAgents: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Robust IMU Activity Recognition
authors: Naiyu Zheng, Tianlong Yu, Haochen Yin, Xiaoyi Fan, Xiping Hu, Zhimeng Yin
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is a cornerstone of mobile health, smart environments, and human-computer interaction. However, current deep learning-based HAR models often struggle with heavy reliance on labeled data, position-specific ambiguity, and a lack of transparent reasoning. Inspired by the advanced agents framework, which emulates a collaborative agent using Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose SensingAgents, a novel multi-agent system for robust IMU activity recognition. SensingAgents organizes LLM-powered agents into specialized roles: a group of Analyst Agents for position-specific sensor analysis (arm, wrist, belt, pocket), a pair of Advocate Agents that resolves sensor conflicts through dynamic and static dialectical debates, and a Decision Agent that ensures reliability under sensor drift or failure. Evaluation on the Shoaib dataset demonstrates that SensingAgents significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent LLM models, achieving an accuracy of 79.5% in a zero setting--29% higher than existing agent models and 9.4% higher than deep learning baselines--particularly in complex scenarios where multi-sensor data is conflicting or noisy. Our work highlights the potential of multi-agent collaborative reasoning for advancing the robustness and interpretability of ubiquitous sensing systems.
zh_title: SensingAgents：一种用于鲁棒IMU活动识别的多智能体协作框架
translation: 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）是移动健康、智能环境和人机交互的基石。然而，当前基于深度学习的HAR模型往往面临对标注数据的严重依赖、位置特定的歧义性以及缺乏透明推理的问题。受模拟协作智能体的大语言模型（LLM）高级智能体框架的启发，我们提出了SensingAgents，这是一种用于鲁棒IMU活动识别的新型多智能体系统。SensingAgents将LLM驱动的智能体组织成专门的角色：一组用于特定位置传感器分析（手臂、手腕、腰带、口袋）的分析智能体，一对通过动态和静态辩证讨论解决传感器冲突的辩护智能体，以及一个在传感器漂移或故障下确保可靠性的决策智能体。在Shoaib数据集上的评估表明，SensingAgents显著优于最先进的单智能体和多智能体LLM模型，在零样本设置下达到了79.5%的准确率——比现有的智能体模型高出29%，比深度学习基准高出9.4%——特别是在多传感器数据冲突或存在噪声的复杂场景中。我们的工作突显了多智能体协作推理在提升普适感知系统的鲁棒性和可解释性方面的潜力。
tldr: SensingAgents利用大语言模型的多智能体辩证协作机制，显著提升了IMU传感器在复杂环境下的活动识别准确率与鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体协作框架引入到传统的IMU活动识别领域，解决了传统深度学习方法在数据标注依赖、位置敏感性和可解释性方面的痛点。通过辩证讨论机制处理传感器冲突，提升了系统的鲁棒性。
motivation: 当前基于深度学习的IMU人类活动识别（HAR）模型存在严重依赖标注数据、对传感器位置高度敏感以及缺乏透明推理能力等局限性，难以应对复杂多变的实际场景。
method: 提出了一种名为SensingAgents的多智能体系统。该系统包含：1. 分析智能体（Analyst Agents）：负责针对不同佩戴位置（手臂、手腕、腰带、口袋）的传感器数据进行分析；2. 辩护智能体（Advocate Agents）：通过动态和静态的辩证讨论解决传感器之间的冲突；3. 决策智能体（Decision Agent）：在传感器漂移或故障时确保最终决策的可靠性。
results: 在Shoaib数据集上的实验表明，SensingAgents在零样本设置下达到了79.5%的准确率，比现有的智能体模型高出29%，比传统的深度学习基准高出9.4%，特别是在存在噪声或数据冲突的复杂场景中表现优异。
conclusion: SensingAgents通过多智能体协作和辩证推理机制，有效克服了传统IMU活动识别中的位置模糊和数据冲突问题，为鲁棒且可解释的普适计算提供了一种新范式。

title: An Axiomatic Analysis of Proportionality Notions in Approval-Based Multiwinner Voting
authors: Chris Dong, Jannik Peters
abstract: Even though proportional representation is a fundamental goal in multiwinner voting and a plethora of proportionality notions has been introduced, the normative justifications for choosing one notion over another remain poorly understood. We address this by introducing the axiomatic study of proportionality notions in the approval-based multiwinner voting setting. That is, we define axioms (or desirable properties) that ``good'' proportionality notions should possess. Using these axioms, we then provide axiomatic characterizations of two prominent recently introduced notions: PJR+ and EJR+ [Brill and Peters 2023]. Our characterization proceeds in two parts. Firstly, we provide a characterization of refinements of PJR+ and EJR+. That is, we define axioms such that any notion satisfying these axioms must imply PJR+ (or EJR+, respectively). In particular, the fundamental axiom distinguishing PJR+ and EJR+ from their predecessors PJR and EJR is the classical axiom of monotonicity. Secondly, we introduce our framework of witness-based proportionality notions, that is, proportionality notions that certify ``misrepresentation'' via a witness set of misrepresented voters. In this class, we provide characterizations of PJR+ and EJR+ as the strongest (assuming certain axioms). Thus, by putting both directions together we obtain exact characterizations of both notions. Among our results, it may be worth highlighting that any notion satisfying mild conditions (monotonicity, independence of losers, robustness to fully satisfied voters, and lower quota) refines PJR+. In this sense, PJR+ turns out to be the canonical minimal requirement that one may impose on proportionality.

title: Active Contact Sensing for Robust Robot-to-Human Object Handover
authors: Linfeng Li, Lin Shao, David Hsu
abstract: Robot-to-human object handover is an essential skill for robot assistants, from serving drinks at home to passing surgical tools in the operating room. We expect robots to perform handover robustly -- to release the object only after a firm human grasp while ignoring incidental touches. Existing passive-sensing methods struggle to generalize across diverse objects and human behaviors, as they lack informative perturbations to disambiguate different contact conditions, such as firm grasp versus incidental touch. We propose an active sensing approach for robust handovers: the robot applies information-gathering motions and senses the resulting human-applied forces to infer the contact state. A firm grasp produces forces in multiple directions, while an accidental touch does not. To capture this distinction, we model the contact state with a Bayesian linear model: a distribution over piecewise-linear mappings from robot motions to human-applied forces. This model enables firm grasp detection and active information gathering. In experiments with 12 participants and 30 diverse rigid objects, our method achieved a 97.5% success rate -- over 30% higher than two common baselines.
zh_title: 用于鲁棒人机物体交接的主动接触感知
translation: 机器人向人类进行物体交接是机器人助手的一项基本技能，应用范围从家庭递送饮料到手术室传递手术器械。我们期望机器人能鲁棒地完成交接——即仅在人类稳固抓取后释放物体，并忽略偶然的触碰。现有的被动感知方法难以在不同的物体和人类行为之间实现泛化，因为它们缺乏信息丰富的扰动来区分不同的接触状态，如稳固抓取与偶然触碰。我们提出了一种用于鲁棒交接的主动感知方法：机器人应用信息获取动作，并感知由此产生的人类作用力以推断接触状态。稳固抓取会在多个方向产生作用力，而偶然触碰则不会。为了捕捉这种区别，我们用贝叶斯线性模型对接触状态进行建模：即从机器人动作到人类作用力的分段线性映射的分布。该模型实现了稳固抓取检测和主动信息获取。在涉及12名参与者和30种不同刚性物体的实验中，我们的方法达到了97.5%的成功率——比两种常用基准方法高出30%以上。
tldr: 机器人通过主动施加微小动作并分析力反馈，能更准确地识别人类是否稳固抓取了物体，从而实现更稳健的人机交接。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种主动感知策略，通过机器人主动施加微小扰动来区分人类的抓取意图（稳固抓取 vs. 偶然触碰），这在人机协作领域具有很高的实用价值和创新性。其局限性在于目前主要针对刚性物体进行实验，未来若能扩展至柔性或易碎物体将更具挑战性。
motivation: 现有的被动感知方法在处理多样化物体和人类行为时，难以准确区分稳固抓取与偶然触碰，导致物体交接的鲁棒性不足。
method: 提出一种主动感知方法：机器人通过施加特定的信息获取动作，利用贝叶斯线性模型建立机器人动作到人类作用力之间的分段线性映射，从而区分稳固抓取与偶然触碰。
results: 在涉及12名参与者和30种不同刚性物体的实验中，该方法的成功率达到97.5%，比现有两种常用基准方法高出30%以上。
conclusion: 通过主动施加扰动并结合贝叶斯线性模型进行力反馈分析，该方法能够实现高鲁棒性的人机物体交接，显著优于传统的被动感知方案。

title: Advancing Aesthetic Image Generation via Composition Transfer
authors: Kai Zou, Zhiwei Zhao, Bin Liu, Nenghai Yu
abstract: Composition is a cornerstone of visual aesthetics, influencing the appeal of an image. While its principles operate independently of specific content, in practice, composition is often coupled with semantics. As a result, existing methods often enhance composition either through implicit learning or by semantics-based layout control, rather than explicitly modeling composition itself. To address this gap, we introduce Composer, a framework rooted in aesthetic theory, designed to model composition in a semantic-agnostic manner. First, it supports composition transfer by extracting key composition-aware representations from a reference image and leveraging a tailored conditional guidance module to control composition based on pre-trained diffusion models. Second, when users specify only text themes without a composition reference, Composer supports theme-driven composition retrieval by leveraging the in-context learning capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), achieving explicit composition planning. To enhance composition in a reference-free mode, we conduct text-to-composition fine-tuning on the trained control module to enable implicit composition planning. Furthermore, we curated a high-quality dataset comprising 2 million image-text pairs using state-of-the-art generative models to support model training. Experimental results demonstrate that Composer significantly enhances aesthetic quality in text-to-image tasks and facilitates personalized composition control and transfer, offering users precision and flexibility in the creative process.
zh_title: 通过构图迁移推进美学图像生成
translation: 构图是视觉美学的基石，影响着图像的吸引力。虽然其原则独立于具体内容，但在实践中，构图往往与语义耦合。因此，现有方法通常通过隐式学习或基于语义的布局控制来增强构图，而不是显式地建模构图本身。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 Composer，这是一个植根于美学理论的框架，旨在以语义无关的方式建模构图。首先，它通过从参考图像中提取关键的构图感知表示，并利用定制的条件引导模块来控制基于预训练扩散模型的构图，从而支持构图迁移。其次，当用户仅指定文本主题而没有构图参考时，Composer 通过利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的上下文学习能力来支持主题驱动的构图检索，实现显式的构图规划。为了在无参考模式下增强构图，我们对训练好的控制模块进行了文本到构图的微调，以实现隐式构图规划。此外，我们利用最先进的生成模型策划了一个包含 200 万个高质量图文对的数据集，以支持模型训练。实验结果表明，Composer 显著提升了文本生成图像任务中的美学质量，并促进了个性化的构图控制和迁移，为用户在创作过程中提供了精准度和灵活性。
tldr: Composer 是一个通过显式建模构图来提升图像美学的生成框架，支持构图迁移与基于文本的主题构图规划，实现了构图与语义的解耦。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将构图从语义中解耦，通过显式建模构图来实现美学图像生成。它结合了扩散模型和大型视觉语言模型（LVLM），既支持基于参考图的构图迁移，也支持基于文本的主题驱动构图规划，方法论非常全面且实用。
motivation: 现有的图像生成方法往往将构图与语义耦合，缺乏对构图本身的显式建模。为了解决这一问题，研究者旨在开发一种能够以语义无关方式建模构图的框架，从而提升图像的美学表现。
method: 提出 Composer 框架：1. 通过提取参考图的构图表示并利用条件引导模块进行构图迁移；2. 利用 LVLM 的上下文学习能力进行主题驱动的构图规划；3. 对控制模块进行文本到构图的微调以实现无参考模式下的隐式构图规划；4. 构建了包含 200 万高质量图文对的数据集进行训练。
results: 实验表明，Composer 显著提升了文本生成图像的美学质量，并实现了精确的构图控制和迁移，为用户提供了更具灵活性和精准度的创作工具。
conclusion: Composer 框架成功实现了语义无关的构图建模，在提升文本生成图像的美学质量、构图迁移及个性化控制方面表现出色，为图像创作提供了更强的灵活性。

title: VocalParse: Towards Unified and Scalable Singing Voice Transcription with Large Audio Language Models
authors: Yukun Chen, Tianrui Wang, Zhaoxi Mu, Xinyu Yang, EngSiong Chng
abstract: High-quality singing annotations are fundamental to modern Singing Voice Synthesis (SVS) systems. However, obtaining these annotations at scale through manual labeling is unrealistic due to the substantial labor and musical expertise required, making automatic annotation highly necessary. Despite their utility, current automatic transcription systems face significant challenges: they often rely on complex multi-stage pipelines, struggle to recover text-note alignments, and exhibit poor generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) singing data. To alleviate these issues, we present VocalParse, a unified singing voice transcription (SVT) model built upon a Large Audio Language Model (LALM). Specifically, our novel contribution is to introduce an interleaved prompting formulation that jointly models lyrics, melody, and word-note correspondence, yielding a generated sequence that directly maps to a structured musical score. Furthermore, we propose a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) style prompting strategy, which decodes lyrics first as a semantic scaffold, significantly mitigating the context disruption problem while preserving the structural benefits of interleaved generation. Experiments demonstrate that VocalParse achieves state-of-the-art SVT performance on multiple singing datasets. The source code and checkpoint are available at https://github.com/pymaster17/VocalParse.
zh_title: VocalParse：迈向基于大音频语言模型的统一且可扩展的歌唱语音转录
translation: 高质量的歌唱标注是现代歌唱语音合成（SVS）系统的基础。然而，由于需要大量的劳动和音乐专业知识，通过人工标注大规模获取这些标注是不现实的，因此自动标注变得非常必要。尽管现有自动转录系统很有用，但它们面临重大挑战：通常依赖复杂的多阶段流程，难以恢复文本与音符的对齐，且对分布外（OOD）歌唱数据的泛化能力较差。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了 VocalParse，这是一个基于大音频语言模型（LALM）的统一歌唱语音转录（SVT）模型。具体而言，我们的创新贡献是引入了一种交错提示公式，联合建模歌词、旋律和词音对应关系，从而生成直接映射到结构化乐谱的序列。此外，我们提出了一种思维链（CoT）式的提示策略，首先解码歌词作为语义支架，在保留交错生成结构优势的同时，显著缓解了上下文中断问题。实验表明，VocalParse 在多个歌唱数据集上实现了最先进的 SVT 性能。源代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/pymaster17/VocalParse 获取。
tldr: VocalParse 是一种利用大音频语言模型进行歌唱语音转录的新方法，通过思维链和交错提示技术，实现了歌词与旋律的统一高质量自动标注。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将音频大模型（LALM）应用于歌唱语音转录任务，通过交错提示（Interleaved Prompting）和思维链（CoT）策略解决了传统多阶段流程复杂且难以对齐的问题。其局限性在于未在文中提及对极长音频或极端噪声环境下的鲁棒性表现。
motivation: 手动标注歌唱数据成本高昂，而现有的自动化转录系统存在流程复杂、难以对齐歌词与音符以及对分布外（OOD）数据泛化能力差的问题。
method: 提出 VocalParse 模型，基于大音频语言模型（LALM），采用交错提示策略（Interleaved Prompting）联合建模歌词、旋律和词音对应关系，并引入思维链（CoT）提示策略先解码歌词作为语义支架。
results: VocalParse 在多个歌唱数据集上实现了最先进的歌唱语音转录性能。
conclusion: VocalParse 通过统一的生成框架有效提升了歌唱语音转录的性能与泛化能力，为自动化歌唱标注提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: Beyond Retrieval: A Multitask Benchmark and Model for Code Search
authors: Siqiao Xue, Zihan Liao, Jin Qin, Ziyin Zhang, Yixiang Mu, Fan Zhou, Hang Yu
abstract: Code search has usually been evaluated as first-stage retrieval, even though production systems rely on broader pipelines with reranking and developer-style queries. Existing benchmarks also suffer from data contamination, label noise, and degenerate binary relevance.
