ai_comments: 该研究揭示了相位在超分辨率中的关键作用，打破了传统上仅考虑幅值而忽略相位的局限。通过明确定义不同相位体制下的分辨率界限，该论文为评估现有超分辨率算法的性能提供了理论基准，并指出了不同算法的优劣，具有重要的理论参考价值。
motivation: 现有超分辨率理论多关注幅值影响，忽略了复数信号中相对相位对分辨率限制的影响，亟需建立一个能够表征相位如何影响源检测和位置估计的理论框架。
method: 通过理论推导建立了包含复数振幅和非平凡相对相位的两点模型，导出了超分辨率上限（SRUs）和下限（SRLs），并结合数值实验对不同相位体制下的分辨率缩放规律进行了验证。
results: 研究发现相位显著改变了分辨率极限：在同相体制下保持经典缩放指数；在异相体制下，相位能显著改善分辨率，将源检测缩放阶数提升至σ/m，位置估计提升至(σ/m)^1/2。同时验证了l0、ML和ESPRIT算法的优越性，以及SVT、MUSIC和凸优化方法的非最优性。
conclusion: 相位不仅是超分辨率中的干扰项，还是提升稳定分辨率的关键因素。该研究通过建立包含相位信息的两点分辨率理论，证明了在特定相位条件下可以突破传统分辨率限制。

title: Multiuser OTFS Channel Parameter Estimation Toward Grid-Independent Regime
authors: Hanning Wang, Rong-Rong Chen, Arman Farhang
abstract: We study channel parameter estimation for multiuser orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) systems in the delay-Doppler (DD) domain. To enable structured parametric estimation, we adopt a multi-user pilot cyclic prefix (MU-PCP) design, which multiplexes users along the Doppler dimension while preserving a separable exponential structure. This structure facilitates high-resolution estimation of fractional delay and Doppler parameters in the multiuser setting. Building on this framework, we extend weighted MUSIC (W-MUSIC) to multiuser OTFS, providing a computationally efficient approach with mild grid dependency, and develop a matrix pencil (MP)-based method that achieves fully grid-independent delay-Doppler parameter estimation. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and reveal a robustness-complexity tradeoff: W-MUSIC performs better at low SNR, while MP achieves higher estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high SNR with significantly lower computational complexity.
zh_title: 面向网格无关机制的多用户OTFS信道参数估计
translation: 我们研究了延迟-多普勒（DD）域中多用户正交时频空间（OTFS）系统的信道参数估计。为了实现结构化的参数估计，我们采用了多用户导频循环前缀（MU-PCP）设计，它在多普勒维度上复用用户，同时保留了可分离的指数结构。这种结构有助于在多用户设置中进行分数延迟和多普勒参数的高分辨率估计。在此框架的基础上，我们将加权MUSIC（W-MUSIC）扩展到多用户OTFS，提供了一种具有轻微网格依赖性的计算高效方法，并开发了一种基于矩阵束（MP）的方法，实现了完全网格无关的延迟-多普勒参数估计。数值结果证明了所提方法的有效性，并揭示了鲁棒性与复杂度的权衡：W-MUSIC在低信噪比下表现更好，而MP在中高信噪比下以显著更低的计算复杂度实现了更高的估计精度。
tldr: 本文提出了MU-PCP设计和基于矩阵束的方法，实现了多用户OTFS系统中高精度、完全网格无关的延迟-多普勒信道估计。
ai_comments: 该论文针对多用户OTFS系统提出了创新的信道参数估计方案，通过MU-PCP设计实现了参数的分离，并成功将矩阵束（MP）方法应用于实现完全网格无关的估计，在计算复杂度和估计精度之间取得了很好的权衡。
motivation: 解决多用户OTFS系统中延迟-多普勒域信道参数估计的挑战，特别是克服传统方法对网格的依赖，提升估计精度与效率。
method: 采用多用户导频循环前缀（MU-PCP）设计以保持可分离的指数结构；扩展加权多重信号分类（W-MUSIC）算法；开发基于矩阵束（MP）的估计方法以实现完全网格无关的参数估计。
results: 数值结果表明，W-MUSIC在低信噪比下表现更佳，而MP方法在中高信噪比下具有更高的估计精度，且计算复杂度显著降低。
conclusion: 提出的MU-PCP设计结合W-MUSIC和MP方法，能够有效实现多用户OTFS系统中的高分辨率、网格无关的延迟-多普勒参数估计。

title: RF-Analyzer: Can Vision-Language Models Learn RF Understanding from Synthetic Data?
authors: Anis Bara, Lina Bariah, Hang Zou, Brahim Mefgouda, Merouane Debbah
abstract: Understanding the wireless spectrum is a fundamen- tal requirement for intelligent communication systems, however, interpreting spectrograms requires extracting multiple physical attributes and reasoning about signal structure, which is a capability that is not achieved by traditional ML approaches. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrated the possibility of learning such interpretation capabilities directly from data. This paper investigates whether VLMs can learn this capability from synthetic data alone, and more importantly, whether such learned representations generalize to real over-the- air RF environments. To address this question, we introduce RF-Analyzer, an SDR-to-AI analysis platform that integrates live spectrum captures associated with the corresponding VLM- based interpretation, enabling direct evaluation of VLMs outputs on live over-the-air signals. Using this platform, we assess a model trained exclusively on synthetic spectrogram data with general-purpose baselines. To enable systematic analysis, we establish a benchmark framework comprising three metrics, Physical Attribute Extraction Score (PAES), Prompt Leakage Rate (PLR), and hallucination count, to assess signal understanding and grounding. The obtained results demonstrate that VLMs trained on synthetic spectrogram data can generalize to real RF environments, particularly for extracting physical signal attributes such as spectral occupancy, temporal behavior, and SNR. This indicates that synthetic data is sufficient for learning transferable representations of RF signal structure. However, this generalization is limited due to the fact that synthetic training does not provide reliable semantic grounding without contextual priors. In particular, generalization breaks under conditions that are not covered in the synthetic distribution, particularly low-SNR regimes
zh_title: RF-Analyzer：视觉语言模型能通过合成数据学习射频理解吗？
translation: 理解无线电频谱是智能通信系统的基本要求，然而，解释频谱图需要提取多个物理属性并对信号结构进行推理，这是传统机器学习方法无法实现的能力。视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展证明了直接从数据中学习此类解释能力的可能性。本文探讨了VLM是否能仅从合成数据中学习这种能力，更重要的是，这种学习到的表征是否能泛化到真实的无线电射频环境。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了RF-Analyzer，这是一个SDR转AI分析平台，它集成了实时频谱捕获与相应的基于VLM的解释，能够直接评估VLM在实时空中信号上的输出。使用该平台，我们将仅在合成频谱图数据上训练的模型与通用基线进行了评估。为了进行系统分析，我们建立了一个包含物理属性提取评分（PAES）、提示泄露率（PLR）和幻觉计数三个指标的基准框架，以评估信号理解和接地能力。结果表明，在合成频谱图数据上训练的VLM可以泛化到真实的射频环境，特别是在提取频谱占用、时间行为和信噪比等物理信号属性方面。这表明合成数据足以学习射频信号结构的可迁移表征。然而，这种泛化是有限的，因为合成训练在没有上下文先验的情况下无法提供可靠的语义接地。特别是，在合成分布未覆盖的条件下，即低信噪比环境下，泛化能力会失效。
tldr: 通过合成数据训练的视觉语言模型可以理解射频信号的物理属性，但在真实环境的复杂场景及低信噪比下泛化能力受限。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于探讨了利用合成数据训练视觉语言模型（VLM）以理解无线电频谱的可行性，并引入了RF-Analyzer平台和评估基准。其局限性在于模型在低信噪比和超出合成数据分布的场景下泛化能力不足，缺乏上下文先验的语义接地能力是主要瓶颈。
motivation: 传统机器学习难以解释频谱图中的多重物理属性及推理信号结构，研究旨在探讨视觉语言模型（VLM）能否仅通过合成数据学习到频谱理解能力，并验证这种能力在真实射频环境中的泛化性。
method: 提出了RF-Analyzer平台，通过仅使用合成谱图数据训练VLM，并构建了包含物理属性提取评分（PAES）、提示泄露率（PLR）和幻觉计数三个指标的基准框架来评估其在真实射频环境下的表现。
results: 实验表明，仅在合成数据上训练的VLM能够泛化到真实射频环境，有效提取频谱占用、时间行为和信噪比等物理属性；但在低信噪比及未覆盖的分布条件下，泛化能力会减弱，表现出语义接地不足的问题。
conclusion: 合成数据足以让VLM学习到可迁移的无线电信号结构表征，能够实现基本的物理属性提取，但在缺乏上下文先验的情况下，其语义理解和在复杂真实环境中的泛化能力仍有待提升。

title: Spacing-Based Coupling Radiation Control in Pinching-Antennas Systems for Heterogeneous NOMA Users
authors: Ishtiaque Ahmed, Leila Musavian
abstract: Pinching-antennas systems (PASS) offer reconfigurable wireless channels via low-cost dielectric mediums by creating line-of-sight (LoS) communication links. Most of the existing PASS cover mechanisms of equal power pinching antennas for conventional bit-based communication, whereas flexible radiation control remains largely unexplored, particularly for heterogeneous semantic and bit users. In this paper, we investigate the performance of semantic communication (SC) using an adjustable radiation model over PASS, where the coupling strength between the dielectric waveguide and each pinching antenna is determined by the antenna-waveguide spacing. Specifically, the non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-assisted heterogeneous users are served by multiple pinching antennas using spacing-controlled adjustable radiation ratios. Uunder this setting, we maximize the semantic spectral efficiency (SE) subject to the bit-user quality of service (QoS) requirement, successive interference cancellation (SIC) feasibility, and the minimum adjacent antennas spacing constraint. An alternating optimization (AO) approach optimizes users power allocation and positions of pinching antennas. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proportional power PASS model in providing higher semantic SE in different geometrical and numerical settings compared to conventional benchmark schemes.
zh_title: 面向异构NOMA用户的捏合天线系统中基于间距的耦合辐射控制
translation: 捏合天线系统（PASS）通过创建视距（LoS）通信链路，利用低成本介电介质提供可重构的无线信道。现有大多数PASS机制主要涵盖传统比特通信的等功率捏合天线，而灵活的辐射控制尚待探索，尤其是在处理异构语义和比特用户时。在本文中，我们研究了在PASS上使用可调辐射模型的语义通信（SC）性能，其中介电波导与每个捏合天线之间的耦合强度由天线-波导间距决定。具体而言，非正交多址接入（NOMA）辅助的异构用户由多个使用间距控制的可调辐射比的捏合天线提供服务。在此设置下，我们在满足比特用户服务质量（QoS）要求、连续干扰消除（SIC）可行性以及相邻天线最小间距约束的前提下，最大化语义频谱效率（SE）。一种交替优化（AO）方法被用于优化用户的功率分配和捏合天线的位置。仿真结果表明，与传统基准方案相比，比例功率PASS模型在不同的几何和数值设置下能提供更高的语义SE。
tldr: 通过调整捏合天线与波导的间距，实现异构语义与比特用户的高效资源分配。
ai_comments: 该研究通过物理层（天线间距）与上层通信需求（语义通信与比特通信）的结合，为异构NOMA网络提供了一种创新的物理层资源配置思路。限制在于该模型高度依赖几何布局，实际部署中的环境复杂性可能对其性能稳定性构成挑战。
motivation: 现有的捏合天线系统（PASS）多关注同构比特通信且缺乏灵活的辐射控制，难以应对语义通信与比特通信共存的异构场景需求。
method: 提出了一种基于天线-波导间距的自适应辐射模型，并采用交替优化（AO）算法对用户的功率分配及捏合天线的位置进行优化，以满足语义频谱效率最大化及比特用户QoS需求。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的比例功率PASS模型在不同几何和数值设置下，均能显著优于传统的基准方案，提升了语义频谱效率。
conclusion: 通过基于间距的辐射控制，该方案成功提升了异构NOMA系统中的语义频谱效率，证明了物理层配置在支持新型语义通信中的重要作用。

title: Spatial-Magnifier: Spatial upsampling for multichannel speech enhancement
authors: Dongheon Lee, Ashutosh Pandey, Sanjeel Parekh, Daniel Wong, Jacob Donley, Buye Xu, Juan Azcarreta
abstract: While the spatial directivity of multichannel speech enhancement algorithms improves with the number of microphones, fitting large capture arrays into real-world edge devices is typically limited by physical constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose Spatial-Magnifier, a neural network designed to generate virtual microphone (VM) signals from a limited set of real microphone (RM) measurements. Moreover, we introduce the Spatial Audio Representation Learning (SARL) framework, which leverages estimated VM signals and features to condition a downstream speech enhancement system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms existing spatial upsampling baselines across various speech extraction systems, including end-to-end multichannel speech enhancement and neural beamforming. The proposed method nearly recovers the oracle performance achieved when all microphones are available.

title: SEI-SHIELD: Robust Specific Emitter Identification Under Label Noise Via Self-Supervised Filtering and Iterative Rescue
authors: Ruixiang Zhang, Zinan Zhou, Yezhuo Zhang, Guangyu Li, Xuanpeng Li
abstract: Specific Emitter Identification (SEI) provides physical-layer device authentication for wireless communications and Internet of Things (IoT) systems. While deep learning (DL) has significantly advanced SEI performance, label noise severely degrades system reliability in non-cooperative environments. Label noise originates from channel-induced ambiguities, annotation errors, and deliberate data poisoning by intelligent jammers injecting misleading signals. While recent SEI methods attempt to mitigate label noise, they fundamentally rely on corrupted supervised signals to guide sample selection, inevitably leading to confirmation bias and suboptimal feature spaces. To address this challenge, we propose SEI-SHIELD, a robust SEI framework that integrates self-supervised contrastive pre-training with iterative sample selection. Specifically, SEI-SHIELD employs Momentum Contrast (MoCo) with RF-tailored augmentations to extract intrinsically robust, label-independent representations directly from complex-valued I/Q signals. In addition, K-nearest neighbors (KNN)-based noise filtering identifies corrupted samples through neighborhood label consistency analysis in the learned feature space. Furthermore, an iterative rescue mechanism using prediction confidence and prototype cosine similarity progressively recovers correctly labeled hard samples inadvertently discarded during filtering. Comprehensive experiments on the POWDER and ORACLE datasets demonstrate that SEI-SHIELD achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy under various noise rates, substantially outperforming existing noise-robust paradigms, including advanced regularization techniques and sample selection frameworks.

title: Symbolic Regression via Neural Networks
authors: Nibodh Boddupalli, Timothy Matchen, Jeff Moehlis
abstract: Identifying governing equations for a dynamical system is a topic of critical interest across an array of disciplines, from mathematics to engineering to biology. Machine learning -- specifically deep learning -- techniques have shown their capabilities in approximating dynamics from data, but a shortcoming of traditional deep learning is that there is little insight into the underlying mapping beyond its numerical output for a given input. This limits their utility in analysis beyond simple prediction. Simultaneously, a number of strategies exist which identify models based on a fixed dictionary of basis functions, but most either require some intuition or insight about the system, or are susceptible to overfitting or a lack of parsimony. Here we present a novel approach that combines the flexibility and accuracy of deep learning approaches with the utility of symbolic solutions: a deep neural network that generates a symbolic expression for the governing equations. We first describe the architecture for our model, then show the accuracy of our algorithm across a range of classical dynamical systems.
zh_title: 通过神经网络进行符号回归
translation: 识别动态系统的控制方程在数学、工程学和生物学等众多学科中都是一个至关重要的课题。机器学习——特别是深度学习——技术已经展示了其从数据中近似动态系统的能力，但传统深度学习的一个缺点是，除了对给定输入的数值输出外，人们对底层的映射几乎没有洞察力。这限制了它们在简单预测之外的分析用途。与此同时，存在许多基于固定基函数字典识别模型的方法，但大多数要么需要对系统有一定的直觉或洞察力，要么容易出现过拟合或缺乏简洁性。在这里，我们提出了一种结合深度学习方法的灵活性和准确性与符号解的实用性的新方法：一个生成控制方程符号表达式的深度神经网络。我们首先描述了我们模型的架构，然后展示了我们的算法在一系列经典动态系统中的准确性。
tldr: 提出了一种利用深度神经网络直接从数据中提取动态系统符号控制方程的方法，实现了高精度与高可解释性的统一。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将深度学习的灵活性与符号回归的可解释性相结合，为解决动态系统方程发现问题提供了一种新思路，弥补了传统黑盒模型在科学解释性上的不足。其局限性在于未提及对复杂噪声数据的鲁棒性以及在大规模高维系统中的扩展性。
motivation: 传统深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，而现有的基于固定基函数库的符号回归方法往往依赖领域先验知识或容易导致过拟合，缺乏简洁性。
method: 提出一种深度神经网络架构，旨在直接从数据中生成描述动态系统的符号表达式，而非仅仅输出数值预测。
results: 该算法在多种经典动态系统测试中表现出了高准确性，成功生成了简洁且准确的符号控制方程。
conclusion: 该方法成功证明了利用深度神经网络生成符号表达式来发现动态系统控制方程的可行性和准确性，为数据驱动的科学发现提供了一种强大的工具。

title: Two-Timescale Design for Rotatable-Antenna Systems With Imperfect CSI: Rate Analysis and Orientation Optimization
authors: Ziyuan Zheng, Qingqing Wu, Wen Chen
abstract: This paper studies uplink multiuser MIMO with a rotatable antenna (RA) array under imperfect channel state information (CSI), where each base-station antenna can adjust its boresight direction within an angular region. To balance performance and control overhead, we propose a two-timescale design: RA orientations are optimized from statistical CSI on a large timescale, while linear receive combiners are updated per coherence block from linear minimum-mean-squared-error (LMMSE) channel estimates. Under this framework, we derive a closed-form use-and-then-forget (UatF)-based rate expression for maximum-ratio combining (MRC) and a closed-form statistical rate surrogate for weighted zero-forcing (wZF) under imperfect CSI, revealing how RA rotation influences useful signal strength, estimation-error-induced self-interference, and multiuser interference. The analysis shows that the orientation minimizing channel-estimation error differs from the rate-maximizing one, and that MRC and wZF prefer different rotation configurations due to their distinct mechanisms of signal aggregation and error-aware user separation. For the resulting non-convex rotation design problems, we develop a projected-gradient algorithm over a product of spherical caps with explicit derivatives of the required channel statistics and rate metrics. Numerical results verify the accuracy of the large-timescale surrogates and show substantial performance gains from RA optimization.
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, submitted to IEEE transactions for possible publication
zh_title: 具有不完美CSI的可旋转天线系统的双时间尺度设计：速率分析与方向优化
translation: 本文研究了具有不完美信道状态信息（CSI）的可旋转天线（RA）阵列的上行多用户MIMO系统，其中每个基站天线可以在角区域内调整其瞄准方向。为了平衡性能和控制开销，我们提出了一种双时间尺度设计：RA方向在大时间尺度上根据统计CSI进行优化，而线性接收合并器则根据线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）信道估计在每个相干块中进行更新。在该框架下，我们推导了基于“使用即忘”（UatF）的最大比合并（MRC）的闭式速率表达式，以及在不完美CSI下加权迫零（wZF）的闭式统计速率代理，揭示了RA旋转如何影响有用信号强度、估计误差引起的自干扰以及多用户干扰。分析表明，最小化信道估计误差的方向与速率最大化的方向不同，且由于信号聚合和误差感知用户分离的机制不同，MRC和wZF偏好不同的旋转配置。针对由此产生的非凸旋转设计问题，我们开发了一种在球冠积上的投影梯度算法，并给出了所需信道统计量和速率度量的显式导数。数值结果验证了大时间尺度代理的准确性，并显示了RA优化带来的实质性性能增益。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过双时间尺度策略优化可旋转天线方向的方法，在存在不完美CSI的情况下显著提升了多用户MIMO系统的速率性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了针对可旋转天线（RA）系统的双时间尺度设计框架，有效地平衡了性能与控制开销。通过推导闭式速率表达式，揭示了天线方向对信号强度、估计误差及多用户干扰的复杂影响，并为不同接收机架构提供了明确的优化准则。
motivation: 旨在解决多用户MIMO系统中，在不完美信道状态信息（CSI）条件下，如何通过调整可旋转天线（RA）的指向来优化系统性能，同时平衡性能增益与控制开销。
method: 提出了一种双时间尺度设计：在大时间尺度上基于统计CSI优化RA方向，在小时间尺度上基于LMMSE估计更新线性接收合并器。针对非凸优化问题，开发了基于球冠积的投影梯度算法。
results: 推导出了MRC和wZF的闭式速率表达式；揭示了估计误差最小化方向与速率最大化方向的差异；数值结果证明了所提统计速率代理的准确性，并显示了RA优化带来的显著性能增益。
conclusion: 本文提出的双时间尺度优化方案显著提升了多用户MIMO系统的性能，验证了在存在不完美CSI的情况下，通过统计CSI优化天线方向的可行性与优越性。

title: CTseg: A Tool for Brain CT Segmentation, Spatial Normalisation, and Volumetrics
authors: Mikael Brudfors
abstract: This paper presents and validates CTseg, a freely available software for brain CT segmentation, spatial normalisation, and volumetrics. CTseg builds on the Multi-Brain generative modelling framework, providing a CT-specific pipeline that produces tissue maps, deformation fields, and brain volume estimates in the same format as SPM's unified segmentation, thereby extending SPM's established analysis chain from MRI to CT. CTseg is designed for routine hospital CT scans without requiring preprocessing or resampling in deployment. Although CTseg has been adopted in clinical research spanning, among other things, stroke, dementia, and brain morphometry, a systematic validation against an independent reference standard has been lacking. Using paired MR/CT head scans, we evaluate CTseg across four dimensions: segmentation accuracy against an MRI-derived silver standard; spatial normalisation consistency through group-average sharpness and voxelwise coefficient of variation; brain volume agreement via intraclass correlation and Bland-Altman analysis; and downstream sex classification performance from normalised tissue maps. As a baseline, we apply SPM's MRI-based unified segmentation directly to the CT images. CTseg significantly outperformed this baseline for segmentation and normalisation, showed stronger TBV agreement, and achieved comparable TIV agreement. CTseg is freely available at https://github.com/WCHN/CTseg, and all experiment code is included in the repository for full reproducibility.
zh_title: CTseg：一种用于脑部CT分割、空间归一化和体积测量的工具
translation: 本文介绍并验证了 CTseg，这是一款可免费使用的脑部 CT 分割、空间归一化和体积测量软件。CTseg 基于 Multi-Brain 生成建模框架，提供了一个 CT 专用流水线，产生与 SPM 统一分割格式相同的组织图、变形场和脑体积估计，从而将 SPM 成熟的分析链从 MRI 扩展到 CT。CTseg 专为常规医院 CT 扫描设计，无需预处理或重采样即可部署。尽管 CTseg 已在卒中、痴呆和脑形态计量学等临床研究中得到应用，但此前缺乏针对独立参考标准的系统验证。我们使用配对的头颅 MR/CT 扫描，从四个维度评估了 CTseg：针对 MRI 衍生“银标准”的分割精度；通过组平均清晰度和体素变异系数衡量的空间归一化一致性；通过组内相关系数和 Bland-Altman 分析评估的脑体积一致性；以及基于归一化组织图的下游性别分类性能。作为基准，我们将 SPM 基于 MRI 的统一分割直接应用于 CT 图像。结果显示，CTseg 在分割和归一化方面显著优于该基准，表现出更强的 TBV 一致性，并达到了相当的 TIV 一致性。CTseg 可在 https://github.com/WCHN/CTseg 免费获取，且仓库中包含了所有实验代码以实现完全可重复性。
tldr: CTseg 是一款开源的脑部 CT 分析软件，它将成熟的 MRI 分析流程扩展至 CT，在临床研究中表现出优于传统基准的分割和归一化性能。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将基于MRI的成熟分析流程（SPM）扩展到CT影像，填补了临床脑部CT影像分析缺乏标准化工具的空白，具有很高的临床应用价值。其创新点在于无需预处理即可直接处理常规医院CT扫描，且通过与MRI对比进行了严格的验证。
motivation: 现有的脑部影像分析工具多基于 MRI，缺乏针对常规临床 CT 扫描的、经过严格验证的标准化分割、归一化及体积测量软件。
method: 基于 Multi-Brain 生成建模框架，构建了 CT 专用流水线；通过对比配对的 MR/CT 扫描，从分割精度、归一化一致性、脑体积一致性及性别分类性能四个维度，与 SPM 的 MRI 统一分割方法进行了基准测试。
results: CTseg 在分割精度和归一化方面显著优于基准方法，在大脑总容积（TBV）上表现出更好的一致性，且颅内总容积（TIV）的一致性与基准相当。
conclusion: CTseg 是一种可靠且有效的脑部CT图像处理工具，在分割精度、空间归一化及体积测量方面均优于传统的MRI基准方法，能够有效支持临床研究。

title: Quantum Meets SAR: A Novel Range-Doppler Algorithm for Next-Gen Earth Observation
authors: Khalil Al Salahat, Mohamad El Moussawi, Ali J. Ghandour
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) plays a vital role in remote sensing due to its ability to capture high-resolution images regardless of weather conditions or daylight. However, to transform the raw SAR signals into interpretable imagery, advanced data processing techniques are essential. A widely used technique for this purpose is the Range Doppler Algorithm (RDA), which takes advantage of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to convert signals into the frequency domain for further processing. However, the computational cost of this approach becomes significant when dealing with large datasets. This paper presents a Quantum Range Doppler Algorithm (QRDA) that utilizes the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) to accelerate processing compared to the classical FFT. Furthermore, it introduces a quantum implementation of the Range Cell Migration Correction (RCMC) in the Fourier domain, a critical step in the RDA pipeline that realigns the received echoes so that the energy from a target is concentrated in a single range bin across all azimuth positions. The performance of the quantum RCMC is evaluated and compared against its classical counterpart, demonstrating the potential of quantum computing in advanced SAR imaging.
zh_title: 量子遇上SAR：一种面向下一代地球观测的新型距离-多普勒算法
translation: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）因其在任何天气条件或日照下捕获高分辨率图像的能力，在遥感中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，将原始SAR信号转换为可解释的图像，需要先进的数据处理技术。一种广泛用于此目的的技术是距离-多普勒算法（RDA），它利用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）将信号转换到频域进行进一步处理。然而，当处理大型数据集时，该方法计算成本会变得很高。本文提出了一种量子距离-多普勒算法（QRDA），它利用量子傅里叶变换（QFT）与经典的FFT相比来加速处理。此外，它还引入了傅里叶域中的范围单元迁移校正（RCMC）的量子实现，这是RDA流程中的一个关键步骤，它重新对齐接收到的回波，使目标能量在所有方位位置上集中在单个距离单元中。对量子RCMC的性能进行了评估，并与经典RCMC进行了比较，展示了量子计算在先进SAR成像中的潜力。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种量子距离-多普勒算法（QRDA），利用量子傅里叶变换（QFT）加速SAR图像处理，并实现了量子范围单元迁移校正（RCMC），与经典方法相比具有潜在优势。
ai_comments: 该研究开创性地将量子计算应用于SAR图像处理，特别是通过QRDA和量子RCMC解决了经典算法的计算效率问题。其潜在的加速能力对于处理日益增长的SAR数据至关重要。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同量子硬件平台上的实现以及更复杂的SAR成像场景。
motivation: 经典的距离-多普勒算法（RDA）在处理大型SAR数据集时计算成本高昂。需要更高效的处理技术。
method: 提出量子距离-多普勒算法（QRDA），使用量子傅里叶变换（QFT）替代经典快速傅里叶变换（FFT），并实现了傅里叶域的量子范围单元迁移校正（RCMC）。
results: 量子RCMC的性能得到了评估，并与经典RCMC进行了比较，证明了量子计算在SAR成像中的潜力。
conclusion: 量子计算，特别是QRDA和量子RCMC，为加速SAR图像处理和下一代地球观测提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Phase-Time Array Enabled Multistatic Sensing with Multi-Level Fusion for UAV Localization
authors: Ming Gao, Jianhua Mo, Meixia Tao
abstract: Multistatic collaborative sensing eliminates self-interference, achieves spatial diversity gains, and enables wide-range seamless integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). However, conventional data fusion methods suffer from severe error amplification in geometry-sensitive regions. In addition, the conventional analog phased array solution introduces large beam sweeping overhead, whereas the fully digital arrays request high hardware cost. We propose a multistatic sensing framework enabled by a phase-time array (PTA). The rainbow beamforming maps spatial directions to orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) subcarriers, achieving wide-angle coverage with a single radio frequency (RF) chain. We develop two parameter-level schemes-a geometry-aware analytical estimator (GDOP-WLS) and a lightweight multilayer perceptron (PF-MLP)-to mitigate the effects of topological singularities. Additionally, an end-to-end signal-level convolutional neural network (SF-CNN) directly estimates target coordinates from raw signals, avoiding cascaded estimation errors. The results demonstrate that the parameter-level schemes ensure robust convergence under adverse geometric conditions with minimal computational latency. Conversely, the signal-level scheme achieves sub-meter precision but requires an increased computational load. Consequently, the proposed framework establishes a scalable solution for collaborative surveillance of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), providing flexible trade-offs among hardware complexity, latency, and accuracy.
zh_title: 基于相位时间阵列的无人机定位多静态感知多层次融合方法
translation: 多静态协同感知消除了自干扰，实现了空间分集增益，并支持大范围无缝通感一体化（ISAC）。然而，传统的数据融合方法在几何敏感区域会遭受严重的误差放大。此外，传统的模拟相控阵方案带来了巨大的波束扫描开销，而全数字阵列则要求极高的硬件成本。我们提出了一种由相位时间阵列（PTA）支持的多静态感知框架。彩虹波束赋形将空间方向映射到正交频分复用（OFDM）子载波，仅用单射频（RF）链即可实现广角覆盖。我们开发了两种参数级方案——几何感知分析估计器（GDOP-WLS）和轻量级多层感知机（PF-MLP）——以减轻拓扑奇异性的影响。此外，端到端信号级卷积神经网络（SF-CNN）直接从原始信号估计目标坐标，避免了级联估计误差。结果表明，参数级方案在不利的几何条件下确保了鲁棒的收敛性，且计算延迟最小。相反，信号级方案实现了亚米级的精度，但需要增加计算负载。因此，所提出的框架为无人机（UAV）的协同监视建立了一种可扩展的解决方案，在硬件复杂度、延迟和精度之间提供了灵活的权衡。
tldr: 提出一种基于PTA的低成本多静态感知框架，通过多层次数据融合技术，有效解决了无人机定位中的几何误差放大问题，并在精度与计算负载间实现了灵活权衡。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了相位时间阵列（PTA）技术，通过彩虹波束赋形实现了单射频链下的宽角覆盖，有效平衡了硬件成本与性能。其提出的多层次融合策略（参数级与信号级）针对几何敏感区域的误差放大问题提供了灵活的解决方案，在无人机协同监视场景中具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 传统多静态感知在几何敏感区域存在严重的误差放大问题，且传统模拟相控阵波束扫描开销大，全数字阵列硬件成本过高。
method: 1. 利用相位时间阵列（PTA）和彩虹波束赋形实现单射频链的宽角覆盖；2. 开发参数级融合方案：几何感知加权最小二乘估计器（GDOP-WLS）和轻量级多层感知机（PF-MLP）；3. 开发信号级融合方案：端到端卷积神经网络（SF-CNN）直接从原始信号估计坐标。
results: 参数级方案在不利几何条件下保证了鲁棒收敛且延迟极低；信号级方案实现了亚米级精度但计算负载较高。整体框架在硬件复杂度、延迟和精度之间提供了灵活的权衡。
conclusion: 该论文提出的PTA使能的多静态感知框架，通过灵活的多层次融合方案，在硬件复杂度、计算延迟与定位精度之间实现了良好的平衡，为无人机的高效协同监视提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Randompack: Cross-Platform Reproducible Random Number Generation and Distribution Sampling
authors: Kristján Jónasson
abstract: A C library for random number generation, Randompack, is presented. The library implements several modern random number generators (engines), including xoshiro256, PCG64, Philox, ranlux++, and sfc64; 14 continuous distributions including uniform, normal, exponential, gamma, beta, and multivariate normal; raw bit streams, bounded integers, permutations, and sampling without replacement. The engine and the distribution layers are separated so any engine can be used with any distribution. Benchmarks show that Randompack is faster overall than competing libraries, with speedup factors ranging from about 1 to 15 depending on engine, distribution, interface, and platform. A distinguishing feature is reproducibility: with the same seeds Randompack gives compatible results across programming languages, computers, CPU architectures, and compilers. The library includes comprehensive support for parallel simulation. It is accompanied by a comprehensive test suite, benchmarking programs, and example programs. Interfaces to Fortran, Python, Julia, and R have been implemented; their benchmark results are included, although their design and implementation are otherwise outside the scope of the article. Unlike other available C libraries with comparable scope, Randompack is permissively licensed under the MIT license, and it is open source and publicly available through GitHub and conda-forge.
zh_title: Randompack：跨平台可复现的随机数生成与分布采样库
translation: 本文介绍了一个名为 Randompack 的 C 语言随机数生成库。该库实现了多种现代随机数生成器（引擎），包括 xoshiro256、PCG64、Philox、ranlux++ 和 sfc64；涵盖 14 种连续分布（如均匀、正态、指数、伽马、贝塔和多元正态分布）；支持原始位流、有界整数、排列和无放回抽样。引擎层与分布层相互分离，使得任何引擎均可与任何分布配合使用。基准测试表明，Randompack 的整体速度优于同类库，根据引擎、分布、接口和平台的不同，加速比在 1 到 15 倍之间。其显著特点是可复现性：使用相同种子时，Randompack 在不同编程语言、计算机、CPU 架构和编译器下均能产生兼容的结果。该库包含对并行模拟的全面支持，并配有完整的测试套件、基准测试程序和示例程序。文中实现了 Fortran、Python、Julia 和 R 的接口，并包含了它们的基准测试结果。与其他具有相当规模的可用 C 库不同，Randompack 采用宽松的 MIT 许可证，开源且可通过 GitHub 和 conda-forge 公开获取。
tldr: Randompack 是一个高性能、可复现的 C 语言随机数库，支持多种语言接口，能在不同平台间产生一致的随机数结果。
ai_comments: Randompack 的主要创新在于通过分离引擎与分布层，实现了跨平台、跨语言的高度可复现性，同时在性能上显著优于现有库。其 MIT 许可和多语言接口支持使其在科学计算和模拟领域具有极高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的随机数库在跨平台可复现性、性能及语言兼容性方面存在不足，难以满足大规模并行模拟的需求。
method: 开发了一个 C 语言库 Randompack，将随机数生成引擎（如 xoshiro256, PCG64 等）与分布采样层分离，并确保在不同软硬件环境下使用相同种子可产生一致的结果。
results: Randompack 在不同平台上实现了高度可复现的随机数生成，基准测试显示其速度比同类库快 1 到 15 倍，并提供了 Fortran、Python、Julia 和 R 的接口。
conclusion: Randompack 是一个高性能、可复现且易于集成的随机数生成库，能够满足现代并行科学计算的需求。

title: PdNeuRAM: forming-free, multi-bit Pd/HfO2 ReRAM for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing
authors: Erbing Hua, Theofilos Spyrou, Majid Ahmadi, Abdul Momin Syed, Hanzhi Xun, Laurentiu Braic, Ewout van der Veer, Nazek Elatab, Anteneh Gebregiorgis, Georgi Gaydadjiev, Beatriz Noheda, Said Hamdioui, Ryoichi Ishihara, Heba Abunahla
abstract: Memristor technology shows great promise for energy-efficient computing, yet it grapples with challenges like resistance drift and inherent variability. For filamentary Resistive RAM (ReRAM), one of the most investigated types of memristive devices, the expensive electroforming step required to create conductive pathways results in increased power and area overheads and reduced endurance. In this study, we present novel HfO2-based forming-free ReRAM devices, PdNeuRAM, that operate at low voltages, support multi-bit functionality, and display reduced variability. Through a deep understanding and comprehensive material characterization, we discover the key process that allows this unique behavior: a Pd-O-Hf configuration that capitalizes on Pd innate affinity for integrating into HfO2. This structure actively facilitates charge redistribution at room temperature, effectively eliminating the need for electroforming. Moreover, the fabricated ReRAM device provides tunable resistance states for dense memory and reduces programming and reading energy by 43% and 73%, respectively, using spiking neural networks (SNN). This study reveals novel mechanistic insights and delineates a strategic roadmap for the realization of power-efficient and cost-effective ReRAM devices.
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures in main text and 7 figures in supporting information
zh_title: PdNeuRAM：用于节能神经形态计算的无需成型、多比特Pd/HfO2 ReRAM
translation: 忆阻器技术在节能计算方面展现出巨大潜力，但仍面临电阻漂移和固有变异性等挑战。对于丝状电阻式随机存取存储器（ReRAM）这种研究最广泛的忆阻器件之一，创建导电路径所需的昂贵电成型步骤导致了功耗增加、面积开销增大以及耐用性降低。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新型的基于HfO2的无需成型ReRAM器件——PdNeuRAM，它在低电压下运行，支持多比特功能，并表现出较低的变异性。通过深入的理解和全面的材料表征，我们发现了实现这一独特行为的关键工艺：一种利用Pd与HfO2集成亲和力的Pd-O-Hf配置。该结构在室温下主动促进电荷重分布，从而消除了对电成型的需求。此外，所制造的ReRAM器件为高密度存储提供了可调电阻状态，并在脉冲神经网络（SNN）应用中分别将编程和读取能耗降低了43%和73%。这项研究揭示了新的机理见解，并为实现功率高效且具有成本效益的ReRAM器件勾勒了战略路线图。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需电成型的Pd/HfO2 ReRAM器件，通过独特的界面设计显著提升了能效，为低功耗神经形态计算提供了新方案。
ai_comments: 该研究通过对材料界面（Pd-O-Hf）的深度挖掘，巧妙地解决了ReRAM长期存在的“成型（forming）”难题。这一创新不仅简化了器件制造工艺，还显著提升了能效，为神经形态计算硬件的发展提供了重要的材料级解决方案。
motivation: 传统丝状ReRAM需要昂贵的电成型工艺，导致高功耗、大面积占用及寿命下降，同时还面临电阻漂移和变异性等挑战。
method: 研发了一种基于Pd/HfO2结构的PdNeuRAM器件，利用Pd与HfO2的亲和性形成Pd-O-Hf配置，在室温下促进电荷重分布，从而免除了电成型步骤，并实现了多比特存储功能。
results: PdNeuRAM成功实现了无需电成型的操作，具备多比特功能且变异性更低；在脉冲神经网络（SNN）测试中，编程和读取能耗分别降低了43%和73%。
conclusion: PdNeuRAM通过独特的Pd-O-Hf界面设计实现了无需成型的ReRAM，显著降低了能耗并提高了神经形态计算的效率，是实现低功耗存储器的一条有效路径。

title: Confirmation of Binary Clustering in Gamma-Ray Bursts through an Integrated $p$-value from Multiple Nonparametric Tests of Hypotheses
authors: Soumita Modak
abstract: The paper applies a new, nonparametric, interpoint distance-based measure to confirm the inherent groups prevailing in the brightest source of light in the universe: gamma-ray bursts. Our effective metric, in association with clustering methods like Gaussian-mixture model-based and $K$-means algorithms, resolves the conflict regarding the possibility about existence of more than binary clusters in the gamma-ray burst population. Here we carry out multiple nonparametric statistical tests of hypotheses, as many as the number of bursts available from the `BATSE' catalog. An integrated $p$-value achieved from the aforesaid dependent tests solves our concern confirming two groups of short and long bursts.
zh_title: 通过多重非参数假设检验的集成p值确认伽马射线暴的二元聚类特征
translation: 本文应用了一种新的、基于点间距离的非参数度量方法，以确认宇宙中最亮光源——伽马射线暴中存在的固有群体。我们有效的度量方法，结合诸如基于高斯混合模型和K-means算法等聚类方法，解决了关于伽马射线暴群体中是否存在超过二元聚类的冲突。在此，我们执行了多重非参数统计假设检验，数量与BATSE目录中可用的爆发次数相同。从上述相关检验中获得的集成p值解决了我们的担忧，确认了短暴和长暴这两个群体。
tldr: 通过新的非参数统计方法，确认了伽马射线暴仅存在长、短两类，解决了学术界关于其分类数量的争议。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入一种创新的非参数统计方法，有效解决了伽马射线暴分类中关于聚类数量的争议。其核心价值在于利用集成p值方法增强了统计结论的鲁棒性，为天体物理学分类问题提供了严谨的统计学支持。
motivation: 伽马射线暴群体中是否存在超过两个（二元）聚类一直存在争议，作者旨在通过更严谨的统计方法解决这一冲突。
method: 应用基于点间距离的非参数度量方法，结合高斯混合模型和K-means聚类算法，并利用来自BATSE目录的所有爆发数据进行多重非参数假设检验，最终通过集成p值来验证结果。
results: 通过集成p值分析，确认了伽马射线暴群体中仅存在短暴和长暴这两个明确的群体。
conclusion: 研究结论明确支持伽马射线暴存在两个固有群体，即短暴和长暴，排除了存在更多聚类的可能性。

title: A Zero-Inflated Beta Mixture Model for Marginal Mediation Analysis with Compositional Microbiome Mediators
authors: Seungjun Ahn, Quran Wu, Alicia Yang, Zhigang Li
abstract: The role of the microbiome in disease pathogenesis is an emerging field with strong evidence suggesting that dysbiosis is associated with precancerous and cancerous states. Microbiome data present substantial challenges for causal mediation analysis due to sparsity, compositional constraints, and latent heterogeneity. To address these issues, we propose a zero-inflated beta mixture (ZIBM) method for mediation analysis with compositional microbiome mediators. The proposed method accommodates excess zeros through a zero-inflation component and captures heterogeneity in non-zero relative abundances using a beta mixture distribution. Within the potential-outcomes framework, the ZIBM provides estimates of marginal microbiome-mediated causal effects, and model parameters are estimated using an expectation-maximization algorithm. Simulation studies demonstrate that the ZIBM yields more accurate estimation and reliable inference under conditions commonly observed in microbiome data, compared with existing approaches. An application to a real microbiome study further illustrates its practical utility. These results indicate that the proposed method provides a more flexible and robust statistical framework for mediation analysis involving compositional microbiome data.
comment: 19 pages including references; 2 figures; Seungjun Ahn, Quran Wu: These authors contributed equally
zh_title: 一种用于成分化微生物组中介分析的零膨胀Beta混合模型
translation: 微生物组在疾病发病机制中的作用是一个新兴领域，强有力的证据表明菌群失调与癌前病变及癌症状态有关。由于稀疏性、成分约束和潜在异质性，微生物组数据对因果中介分析提出了巨大挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种用于成分化微生物组中介分析的零膨胀Beta混合（ZIBM）方法。该方法通过零膨胀分量处理过多的零值，并使用Beta混合分布捕捉非零相对丰度的异质性。在潜在结果框架内，ZIBM提供了边缘微生物组介导因果效应的估计，模型参数使用期望最大化算法进行估计。模拟研究表明，与现有方法相比，ZIBM在微生物组数据中常见的条件下能产生更准确的估计和更可靠的推断。对一项真实微生物组研究的应用进一步说明了其实际效用。这些结果表明，所提出的方法为涉及成分化微生物组数据的中介分析提供了一个更灵活且稳健的统计框架。
tldr: 提出了一种名为ZIBM的新统计模型，专门用于解决微生物组数据中因稀疏性和成分约束导致的中介分析难题。
ai_comments: 该研究针对微生物组数据特有的稀疏性、成分约束和潜在异质性提出了创新性的统计框架，通过零膨胀Beta混合模型有效解决了传统方法在处理此类复杂数据时的局限性，在因果中介分析领域具有重要的方法学价值。
motivation: 微生物组数据具有稀疏性、成分约束和潜在异质性，现有的统计方法难以有效处理这些特性以进行因果中介分析。
method: 提出了一种零膨胀Beta混合（ZIBM）模型，通过零膨胀分量处理过多的零值，利用Beta混合分布捕捉非零相对丰度的异质性，并在潜在结果框架下使用期望最大化（EM）算法进行参数估计。
results: 模拟研究表明，与现有方法相比，ZIBM 在微生物组数据常见的条件下能提供更准确的估计和更可靠的推断；实际应用也证实了其临床实用性。
conclusion: ZIBM 模型为处理成分化微生物组数据的中介分析提供了一个灵活且稳健的统计框架，能够更准确地估计因果效应。

title: Penalized KLIC Model Selection for the Generalized Method of Moments in Longitudinal Data with Time-Dependent Covariates
authors: Hasan Mahmud, Muia Mathias Nthiani, Hamadou Mous-Abou, Ramezani Niloofar
abstract: Model selection plays an important role in longitudinal data analysis, especially when models are estimated using the generalized method of moments (GMM) in the presence of time-dependent covariates. In this setting, the number of valid moment conditions can grow quickly and may lead to over-parameterized models. The Kullback--Leibler Information Criterion (KLIC) has been proposed as a model-selection tool for this framework; however, the original KLIC criterion may favor overly complex models when the number of parameters or valid moment conditions increases. To address this limitation, this study proposes two penalized versions of KLIC that incorporate penalties based on both the number of model parameters and the number of valid moment conditions. The proposed criteria are referred to as the Moment--Parameter Product Penalty KLIC (MPPP--KLIC) and the Logarithmic Penalty KLIC (LP--KLIC). These criteria provide a theoretically motivated mechanism for balancing model fit and model complexity in GMM-based longitudinal models. Through an extensive simulation study involving both binary and continuous response settings, the proposed criteria are shown to improve the ability of KLIC to distinguish among competing models and to reduce the selection of over-parameterized models. The performance of the proposed methods is further illustrated using the Filipino Child Morbidity dataset, a longitudinal study of child health in the Philippines. The results show that the proposed penalized criteria provide stable and interpretable model rankings and consistently identify age as the most important predictor of child morbidity. Overall, the proposed penalized KLIC criteria offer practical and theoretically grounded tools for model selection in GMM-based longitudinal data analysis with time-dependent covariates.
zh_title: 针对含时协变量纵向数据中广义矩估计的惩罚KLIC模型选择研究
translation: 模型选择在纵向数据分析中发挥着重要作用，特别是在存在含时协变量且使用广义矩估计（GMM）进行模型估计时。在这种背景下，有效矩条件的数量会迅速增加，可能导致模型参数过多。Kullback--Leibler信息准则（KLIC）已被提议作为该框架下的模型选择工具；然而，当参数或有效矩条件的数量增加时，原始的KLIC准则可能会偏向于过于复杂的模型。为了解决这一局限性，本研究提出了两个KLIC的惩罚版本，它们结合了基于模型参数数量和有效矩条件数量的惩罚项。所提出的准则被称为矩-参数乘积惩罚KLIC（MPPP-KLIC）和对数惩罚KLIC（LP-KLIC）。这些准则为平衡GMM纵向模型中的模型拟合和模型复杂度提供了一种具有理论依据的机制。通过涉及二元和连续响应设置的大量模拟研究，所提出的准则被证明提高了KLIC区分竞争模型的能力，并减少了过度参数化模型的选择。通过菲律宾儿童发病率数据集（一项关于菲律宾儿童健康的纵向研究）进一步说明了所提出方法的性能。结果表明，所提出的惩罚准则提供了稳定且可解释的模型排序，并始终将年龄识别为儿童发病率最重要的预测因子。总体而言，所提出的惩罚KLIC准则为具有含时协变量的GMM纵向数据分析中的模型选择提供了实用且具有理论基础的工具。
tldr: 本文提出了两种改进的惩罚KLIC准则，用于解决广义矩估计（GMM）在纵向数据分析中因矩条件过多导致的模型过拟合问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对广义矩估计（GMM）在处理纵向数据时存在的过拟合问题，通过引入惩罚项优化了KLIC准则。其创新点在于将参数数量与矩条件数量同时纳入惩罚机制，有效提升了模型选择的稳健性，具有较强的理论支撑和实际应用价值。
motivation: 在纵向数据分析中，当使用GMM估计且存在含时协变量时，有效的矩条件数量增长过快，导致原有的KLIC准则倾向于选择过于复杂的模型，产生过拟合现象。
method: 提出了两种惩罚KLIC模型选择方法：MPPP-KLIC（矩-参数乘积惩罚）和LP-KLIC（对数惩罚），分别通过在原KLIC准则中增加针对模型参数数量和有效矩条件数量的惩罚项来实现。
results: 模拟研究表明，新方法能更准确地辨别竞争模型并显著降低过拟合风险；在菲律宾儿童发病率数据集的应用中，该方法提供了稳健且可解释的模型排序，成功识别出年龄作为主要预测因子。
conclusion: 提出的MPPP-KLIC和LP-KLIC准则能有效平衡模型拟合度与复杂度，在处理含时协变量的纵向数据分析中，优于传统的KLIC准则，是更优的模型选择工具。

title: A Convolution Process for Sea Surface Temperature Hot-Spot Identification in the Mediterranean Sea
authors: Leonardo Marchesin, Alessandra Menafoglio, Piercesare Secchi
abstract: Sea surface temperature (SST) is a fundamental determinant of global climate dynamics and economic activity. Reliable projections of future SST patterns depend critically on a rigorous characterization of the underlying spatial random field. In this study, we introduce a novel convolution-based covariance framework tailored to geostatistical domains constrained by physical barriers and influenced by vector-driven flows. By discretizing the continuous marine domain into a directed linear network that preserves the orientation of ocean currents, we construct a moving-average stochastic process whose dynamic is encoded via a Markovian transition-probability matrix on the network's vertices. The induced covariance structure emerges as a weighted combination of a spatial kernel and flow-dependent weights, giving rise to a complex estimation problem. To stabilize inference, we propose a penalized estimator that regularizes covariance parameters while enforcing consistency with known hydrodynamic properties. We then embed this covariance model into a Monte Carlo simulation framework to refine RCP-based SST projections and to identify thermal 'hot spots' of heightened ecological risk. Our approach delivers a statistically principled framework that prevents physical inconsistencies -- such as correlations across land barriers -- providing a robust basis for quantifying uncertainty in future SST forecasts and for guiding targeted environmental assessments.

title: A Bayesian Age-Period-Cohort approach for modeling fertility in Puerto Rico
authors: Jomarie Jiménez González, Angélica M. Rosario Santos, Luis R. Pericchi Guerra, Hernando Mattei
abstract: Puerto Rico has one of the lowest total fertility rates (TFR) in the world. Combined with a negative net migration and a high proportion of older adults, its unique situation motivates the need for further demographic analysis. Determining whether low fertility rates are mostly due to period or cohort effects is crucial for developing effective public policies that adapt to changes in fertility and population structures. The main objective of this work is to develop an Age-Period-Cohort model, in order to describe fertility data in Puerto Rico, from 1948-2022 and determine the contribution of period and cohort effects to fertility decline. The APC model was developed following a Bayesian framework, with a Poisson likelihood, RW(2) autorregressive priors for the APC parameters, and Scaled Beta2 priors for the precision parameters. Both frequentist and Bayesian methodologies attribute more importance to cohort effects when explaining fertility changes in Puerto Rico. Birth cohorts born in 1963-1967 onward have notably low fertility rates. There is no evidence of postponement of births in Puerto Rico, contrary to other countries with lowest-low fertility. Birth cohorts born in 1963-1967 onward have notably low fertility rates. This is the first application of APC analysis to fertility data in Puerto Rico, which describes fertility changes in a unique scenario in terms of demographic indicators, and the first APC analysis that shows the predominance of cohort effects when explaining fertility.

title: BOIN Designs for Dose Escalation With Selected Dose Combinations in Oncology Phase I Trials
authors: Yuxuan Chen, Haiming Zhou, Keiko Nakajima, Philip He
abstract: In phase I dose escalation studies for dual-agent combinations, at least one drug often has an established monotherapy dose. Consequently, substantial prior clinical safety data often exist for one or more monotherapies, allowing the study to focus on a subset of selected dose combinations rather than exhaustively evaluating all possible dose combinations for two agents. The Bayesian Optimal Interval (BOIN) design framework is widely recognized for its robust performance and ease of implementation; however, the BOIN for combination design, abbreviated as BOIN-C in this paper, was originally developed to evaluate full combinations and may not be directly applicable for the subset of selected combinations. In this paper, we propose three extensions to the BOIN-C design to address scenarios involving selected dose combinations: (a) BOIN-CS: a generalized BOIN-C design to accommodate any subset of dose combinations. (b) BOIN-CE: Exploration of new off-diagonal dose combinations when de-escalating. This option provides additional opportunities to treat patients with dose combinations that have not been administered. (c) BOIN-CB: Bayesian logistic regression model (BLRM)-guided BOIN design, which uses the BLRM model to break the tie when two dose combinations have an equal posterior probability of being selected. This can be useful when the dose-toxicity relationship is expected to be reasonably aligned with a logistic relationship. These study design options are motivated by practical considerations, and their operating characteristics are evaluated through extensive simulations under various scenarios, demonstrating satisfactory performance.
zh_title: 针对肿瘤I期临床试验中选定剂量组合的BOIN剂量递增设计
translation: 在双药组合的I期剂量递增研究中，至少有一种药物通常已有确定的单药剂量。因此，针对一种或多种单药通常已有大量的临床安全性数据，使得研究可以专注于选定的剂量组合子集，而不是详尽评估两种药物的所有可能组合。贝叶斯最优区间（BOIN）设计框架因其稳健的性能和易于实施而广受认可；然而，本文中的组合设计（简称BOIN-C）最初是为评估全组合而开发的，可能不直接适用于选定组合的子集。在本文中，我们提出了BOIN-C设计的三种扩展，以应对涉及选定剂量组合的场景：（a）BOIN-CS：一种广义的BOIN-C设计，以适应任何剂量组合的子集。（b）BOIN-CE：在降阶时探索新的离对角线剂量组合。此选项为使用未给药的剂量组合治疗患者提供了更多机会。（c）BOIN-CB：贝叶斯逻辑回归模型（BLRM）引导的BOIN设计，当两个剂量组合被选中的后验概率相等时，使用BLRM模型打破平局。这在剂量-毒性关系预期符合逻辑关系时非常有用。这些研究设计选项是出于实际考虑，并通过在各种场景下的大量模拟评估了其运行特性，表现出令人满意的性能。
tldr: 针对双药组合I期试验，本文提出了三种BOIN-C的扩展方法，以优化对部分选定剂量组合的评估，提升了临床试验设计的灵活性。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现有BOIN-C设计在处理组合药物试验中部分组合选择时的局限性，提出了三种实用的扩展方案。其创新点在于提升了设计在特定临床场景下的灵活性和适用性，通过模拟验证了其稳健性，对药物研发具有重要的实际指导意义。
motivation: 现有的BOIN-C设计主要针对全组合场景，无法直接高效地应用于临床中常见的仅需评估部分选定剂量组合的场景。
method: 提出了三种BOIN-C设计的扩展方法：(a) BOIN-CS：适用于任何剂量组合子集的广义设计；(b) BOIN-CE：在降阶时探索未使用的离对角线剂量组合；(c) BOIN-CB：利用贝叶斯逻辑回归模型(BLRM)解决剂量选择平局问题。
results: 通过广泛的模拟研究，证明了这三种扩展设计在多种场景下均能保持稳健的性能，且比原始设计更适用于部分组合的临床试验。
conclusion: 研究表明，所提出的三种BOIN-C扩展设计（BOIN-CS、BOIN-CE、BOIN-CB）在处理特定的组合剂量试验场景中表现出良好的运行特性，能够有效提升试验设计的灵活性和安全性。

title: Dynamic SIR/SEIR-like models comprising a time-dependent transmission rate: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo approach with applications to COVID-19
authors: Hristo Inouzhe, María Xosé Rodríguez-Álvarez, Lorenzo Nagar, Elena Akhmatskaya
abstract: A study of changes in the transmission of a disease, in particular, a new disease like COVID-19, requires very flexible models which can capture, among others, the effects of non-pharmacological and pharmacological measures, changes in population behaviour and random events. We favour data-driven approaches over a priori and ad-hoc methods and introduce a generalised family of epidemiologically informed mechanistic models, guided by Ordinary Differential Equations and embedded in a probabilistic model. The mechanistic models SIKR and SEMIKR which divide the population into disjoint compartments for individuals Susceptible to infection, Infectious (K sub-compartments), Exposed (M sub-compartments), and Removed from the pool of susceptible are enriched with a time-dependent transmission rate, parameterised using Bayesian P-splines. Such a parameterisation enables an extensive flexibility in the transmission dynamics, without resorting to ad-hoc specifications. Our probabilistic model relies on the solutions of a mechanistic model and benefits from access to the information about under-reporting of new infected cases, a crucial property when studying diseases with a large fraction of asymptomatic infections. Such a model can be differentiated efficiently, which makes Hamiltonian-based Monte Carlo sampling feasible after a careful initialisation and tuning strategy. This is particularly important in the present setting with weakly identified directions and challenging posterior geometries. Furthermore, we apply our methodology to study the transmission dynamics of COVID-19 in the Basque Country (Spain) from mid February 2020 to the end of January 2021, showing how the framework can recover plausible temporal patterns in transmission while making explicit the dependence of the results on modelling choices and convergence diagnostics.

title: Fast and General Simulation of Lévy-driven Ornstein Uhlenbeck processes for Energy Derivatives
authors: Roberto Baviera, Pietro Manzoni
abstract: Lévy-driven Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes represent an intriguing class of stochastic processes that have garnered interest in the energy sector for their ability to capture typical features of market dynamics. However, in the current state of play, Monte Carlo simulations of these processes are not straightforward for two main reasons: i) algorithms are available only for some specific processes within this class; ii) they are often computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce a new simulation technique designed to address both challenges. It relies on the numerical inversion of the characteristic function, offering a general methodology applicable to all Lévy-driven OU processes. Moreover, leveraging FFT, the proposed methodology ensures fast and accurate simulations, providing a solid basis for the widespread adoption of these processes in the energy sector. Lastly, the algorithm allows explicit control of the numerical error. We apply the technique to the pricing of energy derivatives, comparing the results with the existing benchmarks. Our findings indicate that the proposed methodology is at least one order of magnitude faster than the existing algorithms, while maintaining an equivalent level of accuracy.
zh_title: 能源衍生品中Lévy驱动Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的快速通用模拟方法
translation: Lévy驱动的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) 过程是一类引人注目的随机过程，因其能够捕捉市场动态的典型特征而在能源领域引起了关注。然而，在当前的研究现状下，这些过程的蒙特卡洛模拟并不简单，主要原因有二：i) 现有的算法仅适用于该类过程中的某些特定类型；ii) 这些算法通常计算成本高昂。在本文中，我们引入了一种旨在解决上述两个挑战的新型模拟技术。它依赖于特征函数的数值反演，提供了一种适用于所有Lévy驱动OU过程的通用方法。此外，通过利用FFT，所提出的方法确保了模拟的快速性和准确性，为这些过程在能源领域的广泛采用奠定了坚实的基础。最后，该算法允许对数值误差进行显式控制。我们将该技术应用于能源衍生品定价，并将结果与现有基准进行了比较。研究结果表明，所提出的方法比现有算法至少快一个数量级，同时保持了同等水平的准确性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用特征函数数值反演和FFT模拟Lévy驱动OU过程的新方法，显著提高了计算速度，适用于能源衍生品定价。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了一个实际的金融计算痛点，即复杂随机过程模拟的效率问题。通过引入基于特征函数数值反演和FFT的通用算法，该方法显著提升了计算速度，且具备误差可控性，对于能源衍生品定价等计算密集型应用具有重要的工程价值和推广意义。
motivation: 现有的Lévy驱动OU过程模拟方法仅适用于特定类型，且计算成本高昂，难以满足能源市场中广泛应用的需求。
method: 提出了一种基于特征函数数值反演的通用模拟技术，并结合快速傅里叶变换(FFT)来提升计算效率，同时实现对数值误差的显式控制。
results: 实验表明，该方法在保持与现有基准算法同等准确度的前提下，计算速度至少提升了一个数量级。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于特征函数数值反演和FFT的通用模拟算法，能够高效、准确地模拟各类Lévy驱动的OU过程，并在能源衍生品定价任务中表现出显著的性能优势。

title: ESG as Priced Crash Insurance: State-Dependent Tail Risk and Deconfounding Evidence
authors: Jiayu Yi, Minxuan Hu, Wenxi Sun, Ziheng Chen
abstract: This research establishes ESG as a state dependent insurance mechanism against equity crashes by addressing the decoupling of unconditional alpha from tail risk resilience. By validating market stress regimes as distinct economic states through a drawdown-based truncation rule, the study demonstrates that high ESG ratings materially reduce the incidence of discrete crash events during systemic drawdowns. To address the selection bias and high-dimensional confounding inherent in traditional linear frameworks, we implement Double Machine Learning as a structural deconfounding layer. Unlike simple predictive modeling, the Double Machine Learning framework utilizes machine learning to handle complex nuisance parameters, allowing us to isolate the asymmetric treatment effects of ESG across different market states. Distributional analysis reveals the underlying mechanism as ESG specifically attenuates the severity of realized tail losses at the most adverse quantiles instead of shifting the entire return distribution. Confirmed by structural estimates, this protection functions as priced insurance that incurs performance drags during stable periods while providing critical resilience when tail risks are most acute.
zh_title: 作为定价崩盘保险的ESG：状态依赖的尾部风险与去混淆证据
translation: 本研究通过解决无条件阿尔法与尾部风险韧性之间的脱节问题，确立了ESG作为一种针对股市崩盘的状态依赖型保险机制。通过利用基于回撤的截断规则将市场压力制度验证为不同的经济状态，本研究证明了高ESG评级能显著降低系统性回撤期间离散崩盘事件的发生率。为了解决传统线性框架中固有的选择偏差和高维混淆，我们实施了双重机器学习作为结构性去混淆层。与简单的预测建模不同，双重机器学习框架利用机器学习处理复杂的干扰参数，使我们能够隔离ESG在不同市场状态下的不对称处理效应。分布分析揭示了其潜在机制：ESG并非移动整个收益分布，而是专门减轻了最不利分位数下的已实现尾部损失。结构性估计证实，这种保护作为一种定价保险，在稳定时期会产生业绩拖累，同时在尾部风险最严重时提供关键的韧性。
tldr: ESG并非提升整体收益，而是在市场崩盘期间发挥“保险”作用，通过降低极端尾部风险提供保护，但需以平稳期的业绩拖累为代价。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入双重机器学习（DML）方法，成功解决了ESG研究中常见的混淆偏差问题，为理解ESG的“保险”属性提供了严谨的因果推断框架。其核心贡献在于揭示了ESG并非无条件提升收益，而是作为一种具有状态依赖性的尾部风险对冲工具。
motivation: 旨在解决ESG在无条件阿尔法（unconditional alpha）与尾部风险韧性之间脱节的问题，并克服传统线性框架在处理选择偏差和高维混淆方面的局限性。
method: 利用基于回撤的截断规则定义不同的市场压力状态，并采用双重机器学习（Double Machine Learning）来处理高维混淆参数，从而隔离ESG在不同市场状态下的不对称处理效应。
results: 实证结果表明，高ESG评级能显著降低系统性回撤期间发生崩盘事件的概率；ESG的作用机制是特异性地减轻最不利分位数下的尾部损失，而非改变整体收益分布。
conclusion: ESG在市场压力期间表现为一种有价值的“保险”机制，它通过降低极端损失来实现风险对冲，但在市场平稳期会产生一定的业绩拖累。

title: Same Voice, Different Lab: On the Homogenization of Frontier LLM Personalities
authors: Avinash Krishna, Kalyana Chadalavada, Unso Eun Seo Jo
abstract: LLM assistant personalities play a critical role in user experience and perceived response quality. We present a large-scale experiment of frontier LLM personalities using external ELO-based traits scoring across 144 traits. We find that all models tested converge on a form of trait expression that is systematic, methodical, and analytical and suppress traits such as remorseful and sycophantic. Moreover, models tend to diverge more in their expression of ``middle-of-distribution traits`` such as poetic or playful, but even these so-called ``creative`` models tend to have more neutral identities. These similarities suggest an implicit emergence of a standard of optimal assistant behavior. In a landscape of varied training methods, character training, therefore, stands out for its uniformity, offering insight into a tacit consensus between model developers.

title: A Study of Consumers Cognitive Load in eCommerce Websites using Eye-tracking Technology
authors: Shojibur Rahman, Ahmed Alif Swopno, Nayeem Ahmed, Ashik Ahmed Fahim, Tabin Hasan
abstract: The aesthetics of e-commerce websites have a big influence on purchasing decisions and customers' satisfaction. Webpage complexity and high cognitive load are responsible for causing an unpleasant experience while shopping online. This research empirically inspects a correlation between users' cognitive load and product pricing, where price plays a vital role in causing web complexity. Therefore, we have experimented on 48 random individuals using eye-tracking technology to observe the eye movement calibration on some reputed e-commerce websites. We measured the cognitive load extracted from users' datasets by analyzing fixation count, saccades, fixation duration, and task completion time. Our study induces new findings on website complexity which varies on the similar product but different price ranges. This research also demonstrates a strong connection between customer perception and visual complexity while making online purchases. In addition, these findings will assist the developers and business analysts to improve consumers' shopping experience in e-commerce websites.

title: What Shapes Participant Data Quality? A Scoping Review and Case Study of Crowdsourced Webcam Eye Tracking in AI Interviews
authors: Ka Hei Carrie Lau, Enkelejda Kasneci
abstract: Webcam-based eye tracking is a cost-effective, scalable method for remote research that effectively reaches broader populations. However, uncontrolled environments and hardware diversity lead to inconsistent data quality in crowdsourcing. To assess current practices, we conducted a scoping review of crowdsourced eye-tracking from 2011-2025. The review confirms fragmented reporting and a lack of established quality benchmarks. To address this lack of predictive insight, we conducted a case study on AI fairness interviews (N=205) using the RealEye platform. Applying Ordered Logistic Regression (OLR) to the platform quality metric, we found that behavioral and technical factors significantly predict data quality. Specifically, within the RealEye platform, higher fixation counts, shorter sessions, and operating system choice yield significantly higher quality grades. Based on this review and platform-specific predictive insights, we provide actionable recommendations to enhance the reliability, transparency, and replicability of future crowdsourced webcam eye tracking in HCI and behavioral science.

title: Safety in Embodied AI: A Survey of Risks, Attacks, and Defenses
authors: Xiao Li, Xiang Zheng, Yifeng Gao, Xinyu Xia, Yixu Wang, Xin Wang, Ye Sun, Yunhan Zhao, Ming Wen, Jiayu Li, Xun Gong, Yi Liu, Yige Li, Yutao Wu, Cong Wang, Jun Sun, Yixin Cao, Zhineng Chen, Jingjing Chen, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Zuxuan Wu, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang, Tiehua Zhang, Zhipeng Wei, Hanxun Huang, Sarah Erfani, James Bailey, Jianping Wang, Wei-Ying Ma, Bo Li, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang
abstract: Embodied Artificial Intelligence (Embodied AI) integrates perception, cognition, planning, and interaction into agents that operate in open-world, safety-critical environments. As these systems gain autonomy and enter domains such as transportation, healthcare, and industrial or assistive robotics, ensuring their safety becomes both technically challenging and socially indispensable. Unlike digital AI systems, embodied agents must act under uncertain sensing, incomplete knowledge, and dynamic human-robot interactions, where failures can directly lead to physical harm. This survey provides a comprehensive and structured review of safety research in embodied AI, examining attacks and defenses across the full embodied pipeline, from perception and cognition to planning, action and interaction, and agentic system. We introduce a multi-level taxonomy that unifies fragmented lines of work and connects embodied-specific safety findings with broader advances in vision, language, and multimodal foundation models. Our review synthesizes insights from over 400 papers spanning adversarial, backdoor, jailbreak, and hardware-level attacks; attack detection, safe training and robust inference; and risk-aware human-agent interaction. This analysis reveals several overlooked challenges, including the fragility of multimodal perception fusion, the instability of planning under jailbreak attacks, and the trustworthiness of human-agent interaction in open-ended scenarios. By organizing the field into a coherent framework and identifying critical research gaps, this survey provides a roadmap for building embodied agents that are not only capable and autonomous but also safe, robust, and reliable in real-world deployment.

title: Towards an End-to-End System for 3D Tracking of Physical Objects in Virtual Immersive Environments
authors: Stanisław Knapiński, Maciej Grzeszczuk, Barbara Karpowicz, Pavlo Zinevych, Wieslaw Kopec
abstract: This work aims to establish an end-to-end system for tracking of physical 3D objects for virtual reality (VR) applications. We focus on training applications requiring real-time tracking of the position of small physical objects and their reflection in VR space. Out goal is to perform object tracking in a "plug and play" manner, without using complex systems with quite large tracking devices or manually implementing object tracking. We therefore propose a system for object tracking via fiducial markers alongside a software harness, to enable fast and efficient designation of objects to be tracked and data streaming solution for end-use applications. The system utilizes AruCo, AprilTag and an original Colored Control Points based fiducial system. It allows for easy tag detection and use of object position data, which are crucial for immersive training environments based on VR and eXtended Reality (XR). We evaluate various tag sizes, detection distances, and different camera devices against the theoretical limits. In effect, we create a complete solution for implementing marker-based, real-to-virtual object position mapping for various applications.
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Reviewed and presented on MIDI Conference 2025, Warsaw, proceedings publication in progress

title: A User-Centric Analysis of Explainability in AI-Based Medical Image Diagnosis
authors: Julia Wagner, Tim Schlippe
abstract: In recent years, AI systems in the medical domain have advanced significantly. However, despite outperforming humans, they are rarely used in practice since it is often not clear how they make their decisions. Optimal explanation and visualization of the decision process are often lacking. Therefore, we conducted a comparative user-centric analysis of the latest state-of-the-art textual, visual and multimodal explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods for medical image diagnosis. Our survey of 33 physicians showed that 88% agree that it is important that AI explains the diagnosis -- 64% even strongly agree. A combination of bounding box and report is rated better than the other tested XAI methods in the evaluated aspects understandability, completeness, speed, and applicability. We even tested the potential negative impact of false AI-based medical image diagnoses and found that 50% of the participants trusted false AI diagnoses over all tested XAI methods.
comment: The 4th International Workshop on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Pavia, Italy, 26 June 2025

title: From Passive Feeds to Guided Discovery: AI-Initiated Interaction for Vague Intent in Content Exploration
authors: Yu Xie, Ying Qi
abstract: Recommendation feeds work well when people are simply browsing, and search works well when they can formulate a query. Between these two cases is a common but poorly supported state: users feel that their feed has become repetitive, yet cannot clearly specify what they want instead. We refer to this state as vague intent. We present Red-Rec, an AI-supported exploration interface for this middle ground. After a period of browsing, the system summarizes patterns in the current feed (e.g., dominant content categories and possible latent interests), offers clickable exploration options, asks at most one follow-up question, and then gradually blends new content into the feed. The design is motivated by a formative study which found that users often recognize feed staleness but struggle to articulate alternatives, suggesting the need for proactive and low-effort interaction.We evaluated Red-Rec in a mixed-design lab study against three comparison conditions: a passive feed, search, and a user-initiated chat interface. Compared with user-initiated chat, Red-Rec led to broader exploration, higher serendipity ratings, and lower interaction effort. Participants in the AI-initiated condition typed very little , relying mainly on option selection, whereas participants in the user-initiated chat condition typed substantially more . We discuss how proactive, option-based AI support can help users move beyond repetitive feeds without undermining their sense of control, and we outline design implications for recommendation interfaces that support open-ended exploration.

title: An End-to-End Framework for Building Large Language Models for Software Operations
authors: Jingkai He, Pengfei Chen, Chenghui Wu, Shuang Liang, Ye Li, Gou Tan, Xiadao Wen, Chuanfu Zhang
abstract: In the field of software operations, Large Language Models (LLMs) have attracted increasing attention. However, existing research has not yet achieved efficient and effective end-to-end intelligent operations due to low-quality data, fragmented knowledge and insufficient learning. To explore the potential of LLMs in software operations, we propose OpsLLM, a domain-specific LLM that supports both knowledge-based question answering (QA) and root cause analysis (RCA). Moreover, we disclose the detailed workflow for building LLMs specifically in the software operations domain. First, a Human-in-the-Loop mechanism is introduced to curate highquality data from a large collection of operational raw data and construct a fine-tuning dataset. Then, based on the data, supervised fine-tuning is conducted to achieve a base model. Furthermore, we introduce a domain process reward model (DPRM) during the reinforcement learning stage to optimize the accuracy and reliability of the fine-tuned model on RCA tasks. Experimental results on the tasks with diverse difficulties demonstrate that OpsLLMs effectively learns and aligns with the operational domain knowledge infused, outperforming existing open-source and closed-source LLMs in accuracy with improvements of 0.2%~5.7% on QA tasks and 2.7% ~70.3% on RCA tasks, while exhibiting strong transferability. Moreover, we will open-source three versions of OpsLLM with 7B, 14B and 32B parameters, along with a 15K fine-tuning dataset.

title: eOptShrinkQ: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression Through Optimal Spectral Denoising and Quantization
authors: Pei-Chun Su
abstract:
We show that the key-value (KV) cache in transformer attention heads admits a natural decomposition into a low-rank \emph{shared context} component and a full-rank \emph{per-token} residual, well described by the spiked random matrix model. This observation leads to eOptShrinkQ, a two-stage compression pipeline: optimal singular value shrinkage (eOptShrink) automatically extracts the shared structure, and the residual -- which satisfies the \emph{thin shell property} with delocalized coordinates -- is quantized by TurboQuant~\citep{zandieh2025turboquant}, a recently proposed per-vector scalar quantizer with near-optimal distortion guarantees. By restoring the isotropy that scalar quantization assumes, spectral denoising eliminates the need for both outlier handling and dedicated inner product bias correction, freeing those bits for improved reconstruction.
  The theoretical grounding in random matrix theory provides three guarantees: automatic rank selection via the BBP phase transition, provably near-zero inner product bias on the residual, and coordinate delocalization ensuring near-optimal quantization distortion. Experimentally, we validate eOptShrinkQ on Llama-3.1-8B and Ministral-8B across three levels: per-head MSE and inner product fidelity, where eOptShrinkQ saves nearly one bit per entry over TurboQuant at equivalent quality; end-to-end on LongBench (16 tasks), where eOptShrinkQ at $\sim$2.2 bits per entry outperforms TurboQuant at 3.0 bits; and multi-needle retrieval, where eOptShrinkQ at 2.2 bits closely matches or exceeds uncompressed FP16, suggesting that spectral denoising can act as a beneficial regularizer for retrieval-intensive tasks.

title: On the Invariants of Softmax Attention
authors: Wonsuk Lee
abstract:
Softmax attention maps every query--key interaction into a probability distribution, but the underlying structure remains largely unexplored. We define the \emph{energy field}, the row-centered attention logit, and show that it exhibits invariant properties across models, architectures, and inputs.
  Two classes of invariants emerge. \emph{Mechanism-level} invariants follow from the algebraic structure of softmax attention. They include a per-row zero-sum constraint, a rank bound determined by the head dimension, and spectral signatures that follow from them. \emph{Model-level} regularities are not required by the mechanism, yet hold in every autoregressive language model we test, spanning several architecture families. The energy field distributes its variance over key positions without concentrating at a few. This delocalization traces to a property of the key matrix we call \emph{key incoherence}.
  These invariants have practical consequences. The rank bound confines the energy field to a low-dimensional subspace. Key incoherence yields a per-head training monitor. All results are verified at multiple context lengths and input texts.

title: StateSMix: Online Lossless Compression via Mamba State Space Models and Sparse N-gram Context Mixing
authors: Roberto Tacconelli
abstract: We present StateSMix, a fully self-contained lossless compressor that couples an online-trained Mamba-style State Space Model (SSM) with sparse n-gram context mixing and arithmetic coding. The model is initialised from scratch and trained token-by-token on the file being compressed, requiring no pre-trained weights, no GPU, and no external dependencies. The SSM (DM=32, NL=2, approximately 120K active parameters per file) provides a continuously-updated probability estimate over BPE tokens, while nine sparse n-gram hash tables (bigram through 32-gram, 16M slots each) add exact local and long-range pattern memorisation via a softmax-invariant logit-bias mechanism that updates only non-zero-count tokens. An entropy-adaptive scaling mechanism modulates the n-gram contribution based on the SSM's predictive confidence, preventing over-correction when the neural model is already well-calibrated. On the standard enwik8 benchmark, StateSMix achieves 2.123 bpb on 1 MB, 2.149 bpb on 3 MB, and 2.162 bpb on 10 MB, beating xz -9e (LZMA2) by 8.7%, 5.4%, and 0.7% respectively. Ablation experiments establish the SSM as the dominant compression engine: it alone accounts for a 46.6% size reduction over a frequency-count baseline and beats xz without any n-gram component, while n-gram tables provide a complementary 4.1% gain through exact context memorisation. OpenMP parallelisation of the training loop yields 1.9x speedup on 4 cores. The system is implemented in pure C with AVX2 SIMD and processes approximately 2,000 tokens per second on commodity x86-64 hardware.

title: Memorization In Stable Diffusion Is Unexpectedly Driven by CLIP Embeddings
authors: Bumjun Kim, Albert No
abstract: Understanding how textual embeddings contribute to memorization in text-to-image diffusion models is crucial for both interpretability and safety. This paper investigates an unexpected behavior of CLIP embeddings in Stable Diffusion, revealing that the model disproportionately relies on specific embeddings. We categorize input tokens as <startoftext>, <prompt>, <endoftext> and <pad> with corresponding embeddings $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{sot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$. We discover that $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}$ contribute minimally to generation in memorized cases. In contrast, $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$ strongly affect memorization due to their structural duplication of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$, the only embedding explicitly optimized during CLIP training. This duplication unintentionally amplifies the influence of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$, causing the model to over-rely on it, thereby driving memorization. Based on these observations, we propose two simple yet effective inference-time mitigation strategies: (1) Replacing the tokenizer's default <pad> from <eot> to the ! token before embedding, and masking the $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$; (2) Partial masking of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$. Both suppress memorization without degrading quality, and are readily deployable without prior detection.
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Findings. Code is available at https://github.com/quasar529/sd-clip-mem
zh_title: Stable Diffusion中的记忆现象是由CLIP嵌入意外驱动的
translation: 理解文本嵌入如何促成文本到图像扩散模型中的记忆现象，对于可解释性和安全性至关重要。本文研究了Stable Diffusion中CLIP嵌入的一种意外行为，揭示了模型不成比例地依赖于特定的嵌入。我们将输入Token分类为 <startoftext>, <prompt>, <endoftext> 和 <pad>，并对应嵌入 $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{sot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$。我们发现，在记忆案例中，$\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}$ 对生成过程的贡献极小。相反，$\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$ 由于在结构上复制了唯一在CLIP训练中明确优化的嵌入 $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$，从而强烈影响了记忆。这种复制无意中放大了 $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$ 的影响，导致模型过度依赖它，进而驱动了记忆。基于这些观察，我们提出了两种简单而有效的推理时缓解策略：(1) 在嵌入前将分词器的默认 <pad> 从 <eot> 替换为 ! Token，并掩码 $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$；(2) 对 $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$ 进行部分掩码。两者都能在不降低质量的情况下抑制记忆，并且无需事先检测即可轻松部署。
tldr: 研究发现Stable Diffusion的记忆现象主要源于CLIP的pad嵌入对eot嵌入的结构性复制，通过在推理时掩码或替换这些嵌入，可有效抑制记忆且不损画质。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了一个重要的安全问题，即文本到图像模型中的记忆现象并非完全由提示词驱动，而是源于CLIP嵌入空间中的结构性缺陷。这种分析方法非常精妙，通过解构特定Token（如pad和eot）的影响，为无需重新训练模型即可缓解记忆问题提供了实用的解决方案，具有很强的落地价值。
motivation: 理解文本嵌入如何导致文生图模型的记忆现象，对于提升模型的可解释性和安全性至关重要，而目前对CLIP嵌入在其中的作用尚不明确。
method: 分析了CLIP嵌入中 <startoftext>, <prompt>, <endoftext>, <pad> 四类Token的作用，发现pad嵌入对eot嵌入存在结构性复制；提出了两种推理时缓解策略：(1) 将pad替换为“!”并掩码处理eot嵌入；(2) 对pad嵌入进行部分掩码处理。
results: 实验表明，在记忆场景中，提示词嵌入贡献极小，而pad嵌入通过放大eot嵌入的影响驱动了记忆；提出的两种缓解策略能够有效抑制记忆，且不会降低生成图像的质量。
conclusion: Stable Diffusion中的记忆现象很大程度上是由CLIP的pad嵌入对eot嵌入的结构性复制引起的。通过在推理阶段对这些嵌入进行修改或掩码处理，可以有效抑制记忆现象，同时保持生成质量。

title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing
authors: Cheng Qian, Hyeonjeong Ha, Jiayu Liu, Bingxiang He, Jeonghwan Kim, Jiateng Liu, Bingxuan Li, Aditi Tiwari, Dwip Dalal, Zhenhailong Wang, Xiusi Chen, Mahdi Namazifar, Yunzhu Li, Heng Ji
abstract: Recent advances in large language models have led to strong performance on reasoning and environment-interaction tasks, yet their ability for creative problem-solving remains underexplored. We study this capability through the lens of creative tool use, where a model repurposes available objects by reasoning about their affordances and attributes rather than relying on canonical usage. As a first step, we introduce CreativityBench, a benchmark for evaluating affordance-based creativity in LLMs. To this end, we build a large-scale affordance knowledge base (KB) with 4K entities and 150K+ affordance annotations, explicitly linking objects, parts, attributes, and actionable uses. Building on this KB, we generate 14K grounded tasks that require identifying non-obvious yet physically plausible solutions under constraints. Evaluations across 10 state-of-the-art LLMs, including closed and open-source models, show that models can often select a plausible object, but fail to identify the correct parts, their affordances, and the underlying physical mechanism needed to solve the task, leading to a significant drop in performance. Furthermore, improvements from model scaling quickly saturate, strong general reasoning does not reliably translate to creative affordance discovery, and common inference-time strategies such as Chain-of-Thought yield limited gains. These results suggest that creative tool use remains a major challenge for current models, and that CreativityBench provides a useful testbed for studying this missing dimension of intelligence, with potential implications for planning and reasoning modules in future agents.
zh_title: CreativityBench：通过基于功能的工具重构评估智能体的创造性推理能力
translation: 大语言模型的最新进展使其在推理和环境交互任务中表现强劲，但其创造性解决问题的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们通过创造性工具使用的视角研究了这种能力，即模型通过推理物体的可供性和属性，而非依赖其常规用途来重构可用对象。作为第一步，我们引入了CreativityBench，这是一个用于评估大语言模型中基于可供性的创造力的基准测试。为此，我们建立了一个大规模的可供性知识库（KB），包含4K个实体和15万多个可供性标注，明确关联了对象、部件、属性和可操作用途。基于此知识库，我们生成了14K个基础任务，要求在约束条件下识别非显而易见但物理上合理的解决方案。对包括闭源和开源模型在内的10种最先进大语言模型的评估表明，模型通常能选择合理的物体，但无法识别正确的部件、其可供性以及解决任务所需的潜在物理机制，导致性能显著下降。此外，模型扩展带来的改进很快达到饱和，强大的通用推理能力不能可靠地转化为创造性的可供性发现，而思维链等常见的推理时策略收益有限。这些结果表明，创造性工具使用仍然是当前模型面临的一个主要挑战，而CreativityBench为研究这一缺失的智能维度提供了一个有用的测试平台，并对未来智能体的规划和推理模块具有潜在意义。
tldr: CreativityBench揭示了当前大语言模型在利用物体非典型功能解决问题方面存在严重不足，且现有的通用推理方法无法有效解决这一挑战。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入“基于功能的工具重构”这一新颖视角，填补了当前LLM在创造性问题解决能力评估上的空白。其贡献在于构建了一个大规模的知识库和基准测试，揭示了当前顶级模型在理解物理属性和精细化操作机制方面的深层局限，为未来代理智能的研究提供了关键方向。
motivation: 当前大语言模型在常规推理和环境交互任务中表现出色，但其在需要“跳出常规思维”进行创造性问题解决（特别是基于物体功能进行工具重构）方面的能力尚未得到充分探索和评估。
method: 构建了一个包含4K实体和15万条标注的“功能可供性知识库（KB）”，并据此生成了14K项需要非典型工具使用的任务，用于评估10种主流LLM在识别物体属性、部件功能及物理机制上的表现。
results: 实验显示主流模型虽然能选择合适的物体，但在识别具体部件、功能及物理机制上表现欠佳；模型缩放、通用推理能力和思维链（CoT）策略对提升创造性表现的效果有限。
conclusion: CreativityBench表明创造性工具使用仍是当前LLM的重大挑战，现有的通用推理能力并不能直接转化为创造性发现能力，且简单的模型扩展或提示工程难以解决此问题。

title: Delay, Plateau, or Collapse: Evaluating the Impact of Systematic Verification Error on RLVR
authors: Kazuki Egashira, Mark Vero, Jasper Dekoninck, Florian E. Dorner, Robin Staab, Martin Vechev
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is designed for tasks with verifiable ground-truth answers, real-world verifiers (e.g., static code checkers) can introduce errors into the reward signal. Prior analyses have largely treated such errors as random and independent across samples, concluding that errors merely slow training with limited effect on final performance. However, practical verifiers tend to exhibit systematic errors. This introduces a risk of models learning unwanted consistent behavior from a structurally incorrect reward signal. In this work, we study the impact of such systematic verification errors on RLVR. Through controlled experiments on arithmetic tasks, we show that systematic false negatives lead to similar effects as random noise. On the other hand, systematic false positives can cause a wide range of behaviors from sub-optimal plateaus to performance collapse. Crucially, these outcomes are not determined by the overall error rate but by the specific pattern of introduced errors, making pre-hoc mitigation difficult. Our results show that, in contrast to prior conclusions, realistic verification errors can critically shape RLVR outcomes and that verifier quality has to be understood beyond its sample-level error rate.
zh_title: 延迟、停滞还是崩溃：评估系统性验证错误对RLVR的影响
translation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提高大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的有力方法。虽然RLVR旨在处理具有可验证标准答案的任务，但现实世界的验证器（如静态代码检查器）可能会在奖励信号中引入错误。此前的分析大多将此类错误视为样本间随机且独立的，并认为这些错误只会减慢训练速度，对最终性能影响有限。然而，实际的验证器往往表现出系统性错误。这带来了一种风险，即模型可能会从结构上错误的奖励信号中学习到不希望出现的持续行为。在这项工作中，我们研究了此类系统性验证错误对RLVR的影响。通过对算术任务的受控实验，我们表明系统性假阴性会导致与随机噪声类似的效果。另一方面，系统性假阳性会导致从次优停滞到性能崩溃等多种行为。至关重要的是，这些结果并非由总体错误率决定，而是由引入错误的特定模式决定，这使得事前的缓解措施变得困难。我们的结果表明，与之前的结论相反，现实的验证错误可以关键性地塑造RLVR的结果，验证器的质量必须超越其样本级的错误率来理解。
tldr: 系统性验证错误（特别是假阳性）会严重损害RLVR性能，其影响取决于错误模式而非错误率，这推翻了之前认为验证错误仅会轻微减慢训练的结论。
ai_comments: 该研究挑战了之前关于RLVR中验证错误仅会减慢训练速度的普遍假设，揭示了系统性错误（特别是假阳性）对模型性能的毁灭性影响。这一发现对于理解和构建鲁棒的LLM推理系统具有重要的指导意义，强调了验证器质量评估指标不能仅依赖于简单的错误率。
motivation: 现有研究多假设RLVR中的验证错误是随机且独立的，低估了现实中系统性验证错误对模型学习行为和最终性能的潜在危害。
method: 通过在算术任务上进行受控实验，对比分析了系统性假阴性和假阳性错误对RLVR训练过程及最终性能的影响。
results: 研究发现系统性假阴性的影响类似于随机噪声，但系统性假阳性会导致性能停滞甚至崩溃；错误的具体模式比整体错误率更能决定最终的训练结果。
conclusion: 系统性验证错误（特别是假阳性）对RLVR的结果有决定性影响，其后果取决于错误模式而非单纯的错误率，这挑战了现有的RLVR鲁棒性认知。

title: Agentic AI-Based Joint Computing and Networking via Mixture of Experts and Large Language Models
authors: Robert-Jeron Reifert, Alaa Alameer Ahmad, Hayssam Dahrouj, Aydin Sezgin
abstract: Future sixth-generation (6G) mobile networks are envisioned to be equipped with a diverse set of powerful, yet highly specialized, optimization experts. Such a promising vision is concurrently expected to give rise to the need for scalable mechanisms that can select, combine, and orchestrate such experts based on high-level intent and uncertainty descriptions. In this paper, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI)-based network optimization framework that integrates mixture of experts (MoE) architectures with large language models (LLMs). Under the proposed framework, the employed LLM acts as a semantic gate to reason over operator objectives and dynamically compose suitable optimization agents. The proposed framework is formulated in a model-agnostic manner and bridges human-readable network intents with low-level resource allocation decisions, enabling flexible optimization across heterogeneous objectives and operating conditions. As a representative instantiation, we apply the framework to a joint communication and computing network and design a library of specialized optimization experts covering throughput, fairness, and delay-driven objectives under both regular and robust conditions. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed agentic MoE framework consistently achieves near-optimal performance compared to exhaustive expert combinations while outperforming individual experts across diverse objectives, including delay minimization and throughput maximization.
comment: 16 pages, 16 figures, 9 tables, a version of this work is due to be submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 基于代理AI的联合计算与网络架构：利用专家混合模型与大语言模型
translation: 未来的第六代（6G）移动网络预计将配备一系列功能强大但高度专业化的优化专家。这种愿景同时也带来了对可扩展机制的需求，以便根据高层意图和不确定性描述来选择、组合和编排这些专家。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于代理人工智能（AI）的网络优化框架，将专家混合（MoE）架构与大语言模型（LLM）相结合。在该框架下，所采用的LLM充当语义门控，用于推理操作目标并动态组合合适的优化代理。所提框架以模型无关的方式构建，架起了人类可读的网络意图与底层资源分配决策之间的桥梁，实现了跨异构目标和运行条件的灵活优化。作为一个代表性的实例，我们将该框架应用于联合通信和计算网络，并设计了一个专门的优化专家库，涵盖了常规和稳健条件下的吞吐量、公平性和延迟驱动目标。数值仿真表明，与穷举专家组合相比，所提代理MoE框架始终能实现接近最优的性能，并在包括延迟最小化和吞吐量最大化在内的多种目标上优于单一专家。
tldr: 提出了一种利用LLM调度MoE专家模型的代理AI框架，实现了6G网络中意图驱动的动态资源调度与优化。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与专家混合模型（MoE）相结合，为6G网络复杂的联合计算与通信调度提供了一种意图驱动的自主决策方案。其优势在于将高层语义意图转化为底层的具体资源分配，提高了系统的灵活性和适应性。局限性在于该框架的计算开销，以及在极其严苛的实时网络环境下的推理延迟表现尚未深入探讨。
motivation: 6G网络需要处理多样且高度专业化的优化任务，传统的固定算法难以应对复杂场景，因此急需一种能够根据高层意图和不确定性描述，自动选择、组合并编排专家模型的机制。
method: 提出了一种基于代理AI的网络优化框架，利用LLM作为语义门控（semantic gate）来解析操作目标，并动态组合MoE架构中的专业优化代理（optimization agents）来执行资源分配决策。
results: 数值仿真表明，该框架在联合计算与通信网络中表现优异，能够接近穷举组合的最优性能，且在处理时延最小化和吞吐量最大化等不同目标时，均显著优于单一的专家模型。
conclusion: 该研究证明了基于代理的AI框架能够有效整合专家模型，实现对网络意图的智能理解与资源调度，为未来自适应、意图驱动的6G网络架构提供了有力的理论支撑。

title: When Should a Language Model Trust Itself? Same-Model Self-Verification as a Conditional Confidence Signal
authors: Aditya Ajay Phalod
abstract: Same-model self-verification, prompting a model to audit its own predicted answer, is a plausible confidence signal for selective prediction, but its practical value remains unclear once strong likelihood-based baselines are taken seriously. We evaluate self-verification against two such baselines, LL-AVG and LL-SUM, on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA-MC across multiple model families, scales, and prompt variants. We measure not only correctness ranking, but also abstention quality through AURC and operating-point analyses. The results are sharply task- and model-dependent. On ARC-Challenge, self-verification substantially improves over LL-AVG for Phi-2 and the Qwen models, with the largest gains appearing in Qwen-7B. On TruthfulQA-MC, however, the signal is less reliable: smaller models can become prompt-sensitive, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-8B degrades relative to LL-AVG, and LL-SUM often remains the stronger practical baseline. We therefore do not treat self-verification as a general-purpose uncertainty estimator. In this setting, it is better understood as a conditional confidence signal whose value depends on task type, model family, prompt formulation, and, crucially, the baseline it must beat.
